description_en:
Naloxone (commonly sold under the brand names Narcan and Evzio) is a synthetic mu-opioid antagonist of the morphinan chemical class that is widely used to reverse the effects of an acute opioid overdose. Naloxone is sold under the brand name Narcan as a nasal spray and Evzio as an auto-injector with voice instructions.
Naloxone has been credited with saving an unprecedented number of opioid overdose victims. This is partially due to naloxone programs in several countries to give naloxone to people who use opioids along with the rapid deployment of naloxone by law enforcement agencies and emergency medical services. Many emergency responders and law enforcement are trained to administer naloxone to reverse the effects of opioid overdoses immediately.
Besides its use in emergency medicine, naloxone has been researched in the treatment of depersonalization disorder with promising results.

title: 细花含羞草
description:
细花含羞草（也称纤花含羞草与朱雷玛）是一种原产于南美洲东北部的多年生灌木，在较低海拔地区更为常见呢。其干燥根皮中可能含有高达1.0%至1.7%的DMT。

南美洲原住民曾将其用于制作死藤水煎剂。它通常会与死藤或其他含β-咔啉类单胺氧化酶抑制剂的植物来源一同使用，尤其是MAO-A可逆性抑制剂（RIMA），例如骆驼蓬生物碱。在现代，它也常被作为提取DMT的来源，并且无论在古代还是现代语境中，都会被当作死藤水煎剂的辅料植物来使用。

尽管在细花含羞草样本中尚未检测出β-咔啉类成分，但它在单独摄入时仍表现出精神活性，这提示其机制可能并不只来自其所含的DMT。否则的话，这些DMT会被MAO-A酶迅速代谢，因而几乎不会产生作用哦（至少就其DMT含量而言是这样）。
description_en:
Mimosa tenuiflora (also known as Mimosa hostilis and jurema) is a perennial shrub native to northeastern South America, more commonly found at lower elevations. Its dried root bark may contain up to 1.0–1.7% DMT.

It was used by indigenous South Americans to prepare ayahuasca decoctions. It is typically used in combination with ayahuasca vine or other plant sources of beta-carboline monoamine oxidase inhibitors — particularly reversible inhibitors of MAO-A (RIMAs) such as harmaline alkaloids. In modern contexts, it is also commonly used as a source for DMT extraction, and both in ancient and contemporary settings it is employed as an admixture plant in ayahuasca preparations.

Although beta-carboline compounds have not been detected in Mimosa tenuiflora samples, the plant still produces psychoactive effects when ingested alone, suggesting that its mechanism of action may not derive solely from its DMT content. Otherwise, that DMT would be rapidly metabolized by MAO-A and produce little to no effect (at least insofar as its DMT content is concerned).

title: 美替唑仑
description:
美替唑仑（也称为 去甲依替唑仑）是一种噻吩二氮卓类化学类别的合成抑制剂喵。据报告，在使用后，它会产生类似于依替唑仑的效应，例如焦虑抑制、去抑制、镇静、肌肉松弛和记忆抑制呢。它的效力是依替唑仑的一半，但半衰期长了 60% 左右。

这种化合物在 1995 年由一家日本公司申请了专利，作为治疗焦虑的药物。尽管如此，在 2015 年 9 月被在线供应商作为灰色地带的研究用化学品发布之前，它几乎没有人类使用的历史嘛。

与苯二氮卓类物质类似，突然停止使用噻吩二氮卓类物质对于长期定期使用的人来说可能非常危险，甚至危及生命，有时会导致癫痫发作或死亡。强烈建议通过在较长时间内逐渐减少每天的服用量来进行减量戒断，而不是突然停药哦。

description_en:
Metizolam (also known as Desmethyletizolam) is a synthetic depressant of the thienodiazepine chemical class that reportedly produces etizolam-like effects such as anxiety suppression, disinhibition, sedation, muscle relaxation and memory suppression when administered. It is half as potent and has a 60% longer half-life than etizolam.
This compound was patented in 1995 by a Japanese company as a medication for treating anxiety. Despite this, it has little to no history of human usage prior to its release as a grey area research chemical by online vendors in September 2015.
Similar to benzodiazepines, the sudden discontinuation of thienodiazepines can be potentially dangerous or life-threatening for individuals using regularly for extended periods of time, sometimes resulting in seizures or death. It is highly recommended to taper one's dose by gradually lowering the amount taken each day for a prolonged period of time instead of stopping abruptly.

title: 美金刚
description:
美金刚是金刚烷类的一种解离物质，当给药时会产生持久的解离效应。它是金刚烷胺的衍生物，在药理学上与PCP、氯胺酮和右美沙芬等化合物相关，尽管其娱乐性使用相对罕见。

美金刚最初由礼来公司于1968年合成，作为治疗糖尿病的潜在药物。

美金刚被归类为NMDA受体拮抗剂。这意味着它结合并阻断中枢神经系统中兴奋性受体的信号传导。这些化合物会诱导一种被称为“解离麻醉”的状态，具有许多致幻属性。

在医学上，美金刚主要用于治疗阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病。它也被用作益智药，因为它具有认知增强作用。
mechanism:
##### 谷氨酸能 (NMDA受体) 更多信息：NMDA受体拮抗剂

美金刚是谷氨酸能NMDA受体的中等亲和力电压依赖性非竞争性拮抗剂。NMDA受体允许电信号在大脑和脊柱的神经元之间传递；为了传递信号，受体必须是开放的。解离剂通过阻断NMDA受体来关闭它们。这种神经元的断连导致感觉丧失、移动困难，最终导致著名的“孔洞”。

美金刚与大多数其他解离剂不同，因为它具有快速的电压依赖性结合动力学，允许通过NMDA受体进行功能性离子传输，除非存在足够高浓度的激动剂，这使得美金刚在NMDA受体上的药效学特征更类似于内源性镁，而不是其他解离剂。美金刚独特的药理学特征使其能够在缺乏强烈损伤的剂量下引发神经保护特性，使其在神经退行性疾病的治疗中有用。

##### 血清素能 (5-HT3受体) 美金刚作为5-HT3受体的非竞争性拮抗剂，其效力与NMDA受体相似。

##### 胆碱能 (烟碱乙酰胆碱受体) 美金刚作为不同神经元烟碱乙酰胆碱受体 (nAChRs) 的非竞争性拮抗剂，其效力可能与NMDA和5-HT3受体相似，但由于nAChR反应的快速脱敏，很难准确确定。 Alpha-7 nAChR对拮抗作用产生快速上调反应，这可以解释长期美金刚治疗的认知增强作用。

##### 多巴胺能 (D2受体)
description_en:
Memantine is a dissociative substance of the adamantane class that produces long-lived dissociative effects when administered. It is a derivative of amantadine and is pharmacologically related to compounds like PCP, ketamine, and DXM, although its recreational use is comparatively rare.
Memantine was first synthesized by Eli Lilly and Company in 1968 as a potential agent to treat diabetes.
Memantine is classified as an NMDA receptor antagonist. This means it binds to and blocks the signaling of excitatory receptors in the central nervous system. These compounds induce a state known as "dissociative-anesthesia," which has a number of hallucinogenic attributes.
In medicine, memantine is used primarily in humans in the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's disease.  It also has seen use as a nootropic for its cognitive-enhancing effects.

title: 羟吗啡酮腙
description:
羟吗啡酮腙（也称羟吗啡酮腙）是一种阿片类药物，属于吗啡喃类物质的半合成物质，给药后可产生镇痛、肌肉松弛、镇静和欣快等效应。

羟吗啡酮腙是一种强效且长效的μ-阿片受体激动剂，于1979年合成。它会不可逆地与受体结合，形成共价键，因此一旦结合就不会脱离。这使它具有一种相当特殊的药理学特征。虽然羟吗啡酮腙的效力只有羟吗啡酮的大约一半，但在较高剂量下，其镇痛效应会变得极其持久，持续时间可长达48小时。
mechanism:
羟吗啡酮腙是一种长效、不可逆的μ-阿片受体（MOR）激动剂。这是因为阿片类药物在结构上会模拟体内内源性内啡肽。内啡肽负责产生镇痛（减轻疼痛）、引起困倦，以及带来愉悦感。它们可能会在疼痛、剧烈运动、性高潮或兴奋状态下释放。这种对天然内啡肽的模拟，会带来该药物的躯体欣快感、镇痛以及焦虑抑制效应。

这些效应似乎都来源于阿片类药物对内源性内啡肽的模拟。内啡肽负责镇痛（减轻疼痛）、引起困倦，以及带来愉悦感。它们可能会在疼痛、剧烈运动、性高潮或兴奋状态下释放。对天然内啡肽的这种模拟，最终产生了该药物的各种效应。

据估计，羟吗啡酮腙的效力约为羟吗啡酮的50%-100%。尽管羟吗啡酮腙本身具有活性，但研究表明，它异常漫长的作用时长和不可逆结合，可能是由于其迅速降解为氧吗啡腙。氧吗啡腙的效力约高出20-40倍，并会与MOR形成共价键，因此清除时间极长。

由于其强结合亲和力和长效特征，羟吗啡酮腙的耐受会建立得非常快，而且哪怕只给药一次，也几乎必然会形成躯体依赖。
description_en:
Hydromorphone hydrazone (also known as hydromorphone hydrazone) is an opioid substance of the morphinan class, a semi-synthetic compound that produces analgesic, muscle-relaxant, sedative, and euphoric effects upon administration.

Hydromorphone hydrazone is a potent, long-acting mu-opioid receptor agonist synthesized in 1979. It binds irreversibly to the receptor, forming a covalent bond, and therefore does not dissociate once bound. This confers upon it a rather unusual pharmacological profile. Although hydromorphone hydrazone is only approximately half as potent as hydromorphone, at higher doses its analgesic effects become extraordinarily long-lasting, persisting for up to 48 hours.
mechanism_en:
Hydromorphone hydrazone is a long-acting, irreversible mu-opioid receptor (MOR) agonist. This is because opioids structurally mimic endogenous endorphins in the body. Endorphins are responsible for producing analgesia (pain relief), inducing drowsiness, and generating feelings of pleasure. They may be released in response to pain, vigorous exercise, orgasm, or excitement. This mimicry of endogenous endorphins produces the substance's physical euphoria, analgesia, and anxiety suppression effects.

All of these effects appear to derive from the opioid's mimicry of endogenous endorphins. Endorphins are responsible for analgesia (pain relief), inducing drowsiness, and producing feelings of pleasure. They may be released in response to pain, vigorous exercise, orgasm, or excitement. This mimicry of endogenous endorphins ultimately gives rise to the drug's various effects.

Hydromorphone hydrazone is estimated to have approximately 50–100% the potency of hydromorphone. Although hydromorphone hydrazone is active in its own right, research suggests that its unusually prolonged duration of action and irreversible binding may be due to its rapid degradation to oxymorphone hydrazone. Oxymorphone hydrazone is approximately 20–40 times more potent and forms a covalent bond with the MOR, resulting in an extremely prolonged elimination time.

Due to its high binding affinity and long-acting nature, tolerance to hydromorphone hydrazone develops very rapidly, and physical dependence is almost certain to develop even after a single administration.

羟嗪总结表

羟嗪 是一种第一代抗组胺药物质呢，属于二苯甲基哌嗪/乙烷-哌啶类。它主要作为一种强效且选择性的组胺 H1 受体拮抗剂起作用，其抗焦虑效应很可能归因于弱的抗血清素效应哦。

羟嗪常用于治疗瘙痒感、焦虑、失眠，以及晕动病引起的恶心呢。与许多其他第一代抗组胺药不同，羟嗪对毒蕈碱乙酰胆碱受体的亲和力较低，因此不会产生像苯海拉明那样强烈的抗胆碱能副作用（这些副作用是导致谵妄的元凶嘛）。

羟嗪的娱乐性使用很少，主要出现在更强的抗焦虑药（如苯二氮卓类物质或酒精）无法获得的情况下哦。与更常见的滥用抑制剂不同，它不影响神经递质 GABA，而是通过强效的组胺 H1 受体逆向激动作用发挥抗组胺和镇静效应呢。此外，除了抗组胺活性外，它还显示出对血清素 5-HT 受体、多巴胺 D 受体和 α-肾上腺素能受体的弱拮抗作用。它被处方用于治疗广泛性焦虑障碍、短期失眠，以及过敏反应呢。和其他抗组胺药一样，高剂量的羟嗪可能延长 QT 间期，从而可能导致尖端扭转性室性心动过速（一种潜在致命的心律失常）哦。将羟嗪与其他抑制剂（如苯二氮卓类物质或酒精）合用可能引起极度头晕或嗜睡，因此如果使用这种物质，强烈建议采用伤害减少措施呢。
mechanism:
羟嗪主要作为一种强效的组胺 H1 受体拮抗剂起作用呢。值得注意的是，与其他第一代抗组胺药（如苯海拉明）相比，羟嗪对毒蕈碱乙酰胆碱受体的亲和力较低——因此，羟嗪不太容易引起幻觉状态或谵妄哦。除了抗组胺活性外，羟嗪还作为 5-HT 受体的拮抗剂（这很可能负责其抗焦虑效应）、多巴胺 D 受体和 α-肾上腺素能受体的拮抗剂呢。在第一代抗组胺药中，羟嗪在抗焦虑特性方面是独特的哦。

在药代动力学方面，羟嗪代谢迅速且很容易穿过血脑屏障呢。口服时，它通过胃肠道迅速吸收，并在肝脏中代谢。效应通常在 15-30 分钟内开始，血浆峰浓度大约在给药后两小时出现呢。羟嗪及其代谢物具有相对较长的半衰期；不过，镇静效应通常持续约 4-6 小时呢。在成人中，羟嗪的消除半衰期约为 20 小时哦。

低剂量的羟嗪（结合不到 20% 的 H1 受体）不会引起困倦，但高剂量（结合 50% 或更多 H1 受体）会引起镇静呢。

羟嗪还表现出抗胆碱能和镇静特性，这在治疗焦虑和紧张等疾病时很有帮助呢。其抗胆碱能特性源于阻断毒蕈碱乙酰胆碱受体的能力，这有助于减少肌肉痉挛和与过度胆碱能活性相关的其他症状哦。其镇静特性主要归因于对中枢 H1 受体的拮抗，以及在较小程度上对血清素 5-HT 受体的拮抗呢。这些联合作用有助于其在管理焦虑和促进放松方面的疗效哦。

羟嗪还用于管理恶心和呕吐，主要通过其抗组胺效应呢。该药对 H1 受体的作用有助于缓解晕动病和其他前庭障碍引起的恶心症状呢。此外，羟嗪对化学感受器触发区（CTZ）中多巴胺 D 受体的拮抗作用有助于其止吐特性哦。

作为抗组胺药，羟嗪可有效治疗荨麻疹（风团）和慢性瘙痒等过敏反应呢。通过阻断 H1 受体，羟嗪可减少组胺释放的影响，包括血管扩张、血管通透性增加以及引起瘙痒的感觉神经刺激哦。
description_en:
Hydroxyzine is a first-generation antihistamine substance of the diphenylmethylpiperazine/ethano-piperidine class. It acts primarily as a potent and selective histamine H1 receptor antagonist, with anxiolytic effects likely attributable to weak antiserotonergic effects.
Hydroxyzine is often used in the treatment of itchiness, anxiety, insomnia, and nausea from motion sickness. Unlike many other first-generation antihistamines, hydroxyzine has low affinity for muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, and thus does not produce strong anticholinergic side effects responsible for the deliriant properties of drugs such as diphenhydramine.
Hydroxyzine sees little recreational use, limited mostly to where stronger anxiolytics, such as benzodiazepines or alcohol, are not available. Unlike more commonly abused depressants, it does not impact the neurotransmitter GABA, instead acting via potent inverse agonism of the histamine H1 receptor, which is responsible for its antihistamine and sedative effects. In addition to its antihistamine activity, it has been shown to act as a weak antagonist towards the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, the dopamine D2 receptor, and the α1-adrenergic receptor. It is prescribed for the treatment of generalized anxiety disorder, short-term treatment of insomnia, and allergic reactions . Like other antihistamines, high doses of hydroxyzine can prolong the QT interval, which may lead to the development of torsades de pointes, a potentially fatal arrhythmia. Combining hydroxyzine with other depressants such as benzodiazepines or alcohol can cause extreme symptoms such as dizziness or drowsiness, and as such it is recommended to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.
Tolerance to the CNS effects of hydroxyzine develops rapidly, often in as few as 3-7 days. Tolerance to its sedative effects builds faster than tolerance to its anxiolytic effects. Such, it is indicated for use in short-term or as-needed insomnia treatment.
mechanism_en:
Hydroxyzine acts primarily as a potent histamine H1 receptor antagonist. Notably, compared to other first-generation antihistamines such as diphenhydramine, hydroxyzine has lower affinity for muscarinic acetylcholine receptors — and is therefore less likely to induce hallucinatory states or delirium. In addition to its antihistaminic activity, hydroxyzine also acts as an antagonist at 5-HT receptors (which most likely accounts for its anxiolytic effects), dopamine D receptors, and alpha-adrenergic receptors. Among first-generation antihistamines, hydroxyzine is unique in its anxiolytic properties.

Pharmacokinetically, hydroxyzine is rapidly metabolized and readily crosses the blood-brain barrier. When taken orally, it is rapidly absorbed through the gastrointestinal tract and metabolized in the liver. Effects typically begin within 15–30 minutes, with peak plasma concentration occurring approximately two hours after administration. Hydroxyzine and its metabolites have a relatively long half-life; sedative effects, however, generally persist for approximately 4–6 hours. In adults, the elimination half-life of hydroxyzine is approximately 20 hours.

Low doses of hydroxyzine (occupying fewer than 20% of H1 receptors) do not produce drowsiness, whereas high doses (occupying 50% or more of H1 receptors) produce sedation.

Hydroxyzine also exhibits anticholinergic and sedative properties that are useful in the treatment of conditions such as anxiety and tension. Its anticholinergic properties derive from its ability to block muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, which helps reduce muscle spasms and other symptoms associated with excessive cholinergic activity. Its sedative properties are primarily attributed to antagonism of central H1 receptors and, to a lesser extent, serotonin 5-HT receptors. These combined actions contribute to its efficacy in managing anxiety and promoting relaxation.

Hydroxyzine is also used to manage nausea and vomiting, primarily through its antihistaminic effects. The drug's action at H1 receptors helps alleviate nausea arising from motion sickness and other vestibular disorders. Additionally, hydroxyzine's antagonism of dopamine D receptors in the chemoreceptor trigger zone (CTZ) contributes to its antiemetic properties.

As an antihistamine, hydroxyzine is effective in treating allergic reactions such as urticaria (hives) and chronic pruritus. By blocking H1 receptors, hydroxyzine reduces the effects of histamine release, including vasodilation, increased vascular permeability, and stimulation of sensory nerves that cause itching.

羟考酮（也以品牌名称 奥施康定、罗昔考酮、泰勒宁、Oxecta、OxyIR、Endone、Oxynorm 和 OxyNEO 闻名）是一种从罂粟来源的蒂巴因合成的半合成阿片类药物喵。它是吗啡喃类物质化学类别中的一种麻醉性镇痛药，通常用于缓解中度至重度疼痛呢。它于 1916 年在德国开发，是几种旨在改进现有阿片类药物的新型半合成阿片类药物之一哦。

羟考酮有即释型和控释型两种单成分药物。此外还有联用产品，如 泰勒宁，是与非麻醉成分（如非甾体抗炎药和对乙酰氨基酚）配制而成的呢。

description_en:
Oxycodone (also known under brand names including Roxicodone, OxyContin, Percocet, Oxecta, OxyIR, Endone, Oxynorm, Faroxy and OxyNEO) is a semi-synthetic opioid synthesized from poppy-derived thebaine. It is a narcotic analgesic within the morphinan chemical class and is generally indicated for relief of moderate to severe pain. It was developed in 1916 in Germany as one of several new semi-synthetic opioids in an attempt to improve on the existing opioids.
Oxycodone is available as single-ingredient medication in immediate release and controlled release. Combination products, such as Percocet, formulated with non-narcotic ingredients such as NSAIDs and paracetamol (acetaminophen) are also available.

title: 考拉西坦
description:
考拉西坦（BCI-540，旧称MKC-231）是一种属于拉西坦类物质家族的益智药。它最初由三菱田边制药公司开发并测试，用于阿尔茨海默病。后来，由于该药物在临床试验中未达到终点指标，BrainCells Inc 获得了其授权，用于重度抑郁障碍（MDD）的研究；在此之前，它还获得了加利福尼亚州授予的“合格治疗发现项目资助”。IIa期临床试验结果提示，它可能成为同时伴有广泛性焦虑障碍（GAD）的重度抑郁障碍（MDD）的潜在治疗药物。

考拉西坦在美国较容易通过网络销售商获得，并作为膳食补充剂出售。按剂量比较，考拉西坦的效力几乎是noopept的两倍，因此所需剂量更低，同时能提供许多相似的效应。由于它作用时间较短且偏急性，因此更常见的给药途径通常是鼻吸、舌下含服或蒸发吸入，不过口服同样有效呢。

这种化合物的活性剂量范围在5-20mg之间。和其他拉西坦类药物的常见剂量相比（如吡拉西坦、奥拉西坦、苯基吡拉西坦等），这个范围要小得多。高于20mg的剂量似乎也不会带来额外益处哦。
mechanism: 考拉西坦能够增强高亲和性胆碱摄取（HACU），而这正是乙酰胆碱（ACh）合成过程中的限速步骤。这个过程本质上会让乙酰胆碱积累到高于正常水平的程度。由于乙酰胆碱参与记忆功能，因此这或许可以解释它的益智药效应呢。
description_en:
Coluracetam (BCI-540; formerly MKC-231)  is a nootropic belonging to the racetam family of drugs. It was originally developed and tested by the Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation for Alzheimer's disease. After the drug had failed to reach the endpoints in its clinical trials, it was in-licensed by BrainCells Inc for investigations into major depressive disorder (MDD), which was preceded by being awarded a "Qualifying Therapeutic Discovery Program Grant" by the state of California. Findings from phase IIa clinical trials have suggested that it would be a possible medication for a comorbid major depressive disorder (MDD) with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD).
Colouracetam is easily available and sold through online vendors as a dietary supplement in the United States. Dose for dose colouracetam's potency is nearly twice that of noopept, making it require lower amounts while offering many similar effects. Due to its short acting and acute nature, the preferred ROAs are generally insufflation, sublingual, or vaporisation, though it is still active orally.
The active dose range of this compound is between 5 and 20mg. This is much smaller than comparable doses of the racetam class of drugs (piracetam, oxiracetam, phenylpiracetam, etc.). Dosages higher than 20mg do not seem to offer any additional benefit.

title: 肉豆蔻醚
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
肉豆蔻醚 (Myristicin) 是一种天然存在的苯丙烯类谵妄剂哦。它少量存在于肉豆蔻的精油中，在欧芹 (parsley)和莳萝 (dill)等其他香料中也有少量存在呢。 研究表明它会对内源性大麻素系统产生作用哦。

人们认为肉豆蔻醚和榄香素 (elemicin)一起，是肉豆蔻主要的精神活性成分呢。[来源请求] 当用高锰酸钾氧化时，肉豆蔻醚可以转化为肉豆蔻醛 (Myristicinaldehyde)，然后可以通过还原胺化反应合成 MMDPEA (Lophophine) 哦。[来源请求] 此外，肉豆蔻醚还是合成迷幻剂和共情剂药物 MMDA 的传统前体呢。[来源请求]

据报道，肉豆蔻会引起致幻效果，比如视觉扭曲和偏执观念。在报告中，肉豆蔻中毒需要几个小时才能达到最大效果，而药效和药效残余会持续好几天呢。生肉豆蔻按质量计算含有 5-15% 的精油。肉豆蔻精油的 4-8.5%，或者生肉豆蔻的 0.2-1.3%，是肉豆蔻醚哦。一项研究发现，20 克肉豆蔻含有 210 毫克肉豆蔻醚。

要注意的是，本页面列出的剂量假设大家使用的是肉豆蔻粉，而不是纯肉豆蔻醚，因为纯品非常罕见。如果使用这种物质，非常建议大家采取伤害减少措施呢。
mechanism:
1963年，亚历山大·舒尔金推测肉豆蔻醚可能在肝脏中代谢为 MMDA，这是一种与 MDA 相关的精神活性药物。 然而，这不太可能，因为在摄入肉豆蔻醚后的尿液中没有发现苯丙胺代谢物。人们认为肉豆蔻醚是一种抗胆碱能药物，因为在过量服用时，它会产生类似于抗胆碱能药物的效果 ，但确切的作用机制尚未确定。肉豆蔻醚也被发现是血清素受体拮抗剂，同时也是一种弱的单胺氧化酶抑制剂哦。[来源请求]

榄香素与肉豆蔻醚一起存在于肉豆蔻中，并有助于其致幻效果。榄香素可能具有与肉豆蔻醚相似的效果。它也是合成生物碱麦斯卡林的传统前体呢。[来源请求]

摄入榄香油（一种含有榄香素但不含大量肉豆蔻醚的来源）的人声称，该油产生的视觉效果似乎比肉豆蔻油的视觉效果更类似于经典致幻剂（肉豆蔻油的效果本质上似乎更偏向谵妄和镇静）。

这种区别似乎将肉豆蔻醚描绘成一种更具镇静和精神迟钝作用的药物，而榄香素似乎更具视觉活性和刺激性。这一假设得到了进一步的支持，即虽然榄香素与麦斯卡林有直接的结构联系，但肉豆蔻醚与 MDxx 化合物（如 MDMA）有联系。

榄香素的化学结构似乎是麦斯卡林的碳基类似物，而肉豆蔻醚本身似乎是 Lophophine 的碳基类似物，这些结构差异可能是榄香素和肉豆蔻醚具有略微不同的精神活性效果的指标哦。

在肉豆蔻中没有发现任何化合物直接结合 CB1 或 CB2 受体。肉豆蔻中的三种化合物（Malabaricone C、Licarin A、5-Methoxylicarin A）已被证明通过抑制 FAAH 和 MAGL 酶来充当内源性大麻素调节剂。
description_en:
Myristicin is a naturally-occurring deliriant substance of the phenylpropene class. It is present in small amounts in the essential oil of nutmeg and, to a lesser extent, in other spices such as parsley and dill. It has been shown to act on the endocannabinoid system. 
Myristicin, along with elemicin, is thought to be the main psychoactive constituent of nutmeg.  When oxidized with Potassium permanganate, Myristicin can be converted into Myristicinaldehyde, which can then be used to synthesize MMDPEA (Lophophine) via reductive amination. Additionally, myristicin is the traditional precursor for the psychedelic and empathogenic drug MMDA.
Nutmeg is reported to induce hallucinogenic effects, such as visual distortions and paranoid ideation. In the reports, nutmeg intoxication took several hours before maximum effect was reached. Effects and after-effects lasted up to several days. Raw nutmeg consists of 5-15% essential oil by mass. 4-8.5% of nutmeg essential oil, or 0.2-1.3% of raw nutmeg, is myristicin. One study found 20 grams of nutmeg to contain 210 mg myristicin.
It should be noted that the dosage listed on this page assumes that one is using nutmeg powder and not pure myristicin, as this is extremely uncommon. It is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.
mechanism_en:
In 1963, Alexander Shulgin proposed that myristicin might be metabolized in the liver to MMDA, a psychoactive compound related to MDA. However, this is considered unlikely, as no amphetamine metabolites have been detected in urine following myristicin ingestion. Myristicin is believed to act as an anticholinergic agent, based on the observation that overdose produces effects similar to anticholinergic toxidrome, though its precise mechanism of action has not been determined. Myristicin has also been found to act as a serotonin receptor antagonist and as a weak monoamine oxidase inhibitor. [citation needed]

Elementicin co-occurs with myristicin in nutmeg and is thought to contribute to its hallucinogenic effects. Elemicin may possess effects similar to those of myristicin. It is also a traditional precursor in the synthesis of the alkaloid mescaline. [citation needed]

Individuals who have ingested elemi oil—a source of elemicin that contains little myristicin—report that it produces visual effects appearing more similar to those of classical psychedelics than nutmeg oil, the effects of which seem more deliriant and sedating in character.

This distinction suggests that myristicin is more sedating and cognitively dulling, while elemicin appears more visually active and stimulating. This hypothesis is further supported by the observation that, while elemicin shares a direct structural relationship with mescaline, myristicin is structurally related to the MDxx compounds such as MDMA.

Elementicin's chemical structure appears to be a carbogenic analog of mescaline, while myristicin itself appears to be a carbogenic analog of lophophine; these structural differences may account for the subtly distinct psychoactive profiles of elemicin and myristicin.

No compounds found in nutmeg have been shown to bind directly to CB1 or CB2 receptors. Three compounds in nutmeg (Malabaricone C, Licarin A, and 5-Methoxylicarin A) have been demonstrated to act as endocannabinoid modulators by inhibiting the enzymes FAAH and MAGL.

title: 肌酸
description:

相互作用

肌酸（以及其盐酸盐、苹果酸盐、硝酸盐等衍生物）是一种具有益智作用的氨基酸，天然存在于脊椎动物体内，也存在于肉类、鸡蛋和鱼类等部分食物中。1832 年，Michel Eugène Chevreul 从骨骼肌的碱化水提取物中将其分离出来，由此确认了这种物质。后来，他以希腊语中表示“肉”的词 κρέας（kreas）为其结晶沉淀物命名。早期分析显示，人类血液中约有 1% 是肌酸。

肌酸有助于为全身所有细胞供能，尤其是肌肉细胞呢。当人类将其作为补充剂摄入时，这种化合物会表现出认知增强、神经保护、心脏保护以及运动表现增强等作用，尤其在高强度体力活动期间更为明显。它常被运动员和健美者用来提高力量输出与瘦体重。
mechanism: 肌酸是一种内源性分子，会以磷酸肌酸（肌酸磷酸盐）的形式储存高能磷酸基团。在压力状态或剧烈运动期间，磷酸肌酸会释放能量，以帮助细胞维持功能。这就是补充肌酸后力量提升的原因，而这一作用同样也能帮助大脑、骨骼、肌肉和肝脏。肌酸的大部分益处，基本上都是通过这一机制产生的呢。

Creatine (and its derivatives, including the hydrochloride, malate, and nitrate salts) is a nootropic amino acid that occurs naturally in vertebrates and is also found in certain foods such as meat, eggs, and fish. It was isolated in 1832 by Michel Eugène Chevreul from an alkaline aqueous extract of skeletal muscle, establishing its existence as a distinct compound. He subsequently named the crystalline precipitate using the Greek word for meat, κρέας (kreas). Early analysis indicated that approximately 1% of human blood consists of creatine.

Creatine helps supply energy to all cells throughout the body, particularly muscle cells. When consumed as a supplement by humans, the compound exhibits cognitive-enhancing, neuroprotective, cardioprotective, and exercise-performance-enhancing effects, particularly during high-intensity physical activity. It is commonly used by athletes and bodybuilders to increase strength output and lean body mass.
mechanism_en: Creatine is an endogenous molecule that stores high-energy phosphate groups in the form of phosphocreatine (creatine phosphate). During periods of stress or intense physical exertion, phosphocreatine releases energy to help cells maintain function. This is the mechanism underlying the strength increases observed with creatine supplementation, and the same mechanism similarly benefits the brain, skeletal muscle, and liver. The majority of creatine's benefits are produced through this mechanism.

title: 育亨宾
tags: 吲哚并喹诺里西啶类物质
description:
育亨宾（也称克布拉辛）是一种天然存在的兴奋剂，属于吲哚并喹诺里西啶类物质。它有多种用途，包括作为催情剂和减重辅助剂。最常见的使用形式是盐酸盐。

育亨宾是一种 α2 肾上腺素能受体拮抗剂，也是一种存在于多种植物来源中的吲哚生物碱。它是从 Pausinystalia johimbe 树皮提取物中的主要生物碱，也可见于萝芙木属植物的根部。其许多效应被认为与 α2 肾上腺素能受体拮抗活性有关，这会增强中枢交感神经输出，并提高血压升高、心率增快以及去甲肾上腺素水平。

育亨宾还可用作散瞳剂和交感神经抑制剂，并曾被建议作为可乐定与xylazine药物过量的解毒剂。

虽然一些评论者提到，这种提取物确实帮助他们维持勃起、减轻体重或提升精力，但也有很多人表示，他们所经历的副作用远远超过了获得的益处。有些人服用的剂量明显低于建议值，却依然出现了不想要的副作用呢。
mechanism:
育亨宾最主要、也最被深入研究的作用机制，是拮抗一类称为 α2 肾上腺素能受体的受体，因此它会通过阻止去甲肾上腺素被后续神经元摄取而提高去甲肾上腺素水平。阻断 α2 肾上腺素能受体会升高血压、释放胰岛素并降低血糖水平。不过，育亨宾也会阻断 α1 肾上腺素能受体，只是亲和力较低。另有研究显示，它还能够弱效抑制单胺氧化酶。

在高浓度下，育亨宾会作为拮抗剂作用于多巴胺 D 与 D 受体、血清素 5-HT、5-HT 和 5-HT 受体，并作为 5-HT 的部分激动剂。
description_en:
Yohimbine (also known as corynine) is a naturally occurring stimulant of the indoloquinolizidine class. It has several uses, including as an aphrodisiac and weight-loss aid. The hydrochloride salt is the most commonly encountered form.

Yohimbine is an alpha-2 adrenergic receptor antagonist and an indole alkaloid found in various plant sources. It is the principal alkaloid extracted from the bark of the Pausinystalia johimbe tree and is also found in the roots of Rauvolfia species. Many of its effects are attributed to its alpha-2 adrenergic receptor antagonist activity, which augments central sympathetic outflow and elevates blood pressure, heart rate, and norepinephrine levels.

Yohimbine has also been used as a mydriatic agent and sympatholytic, and has been proposed as an antidote for overdoses of clonidine and xylazine.

Although some users report that the extract helps them maintain erections, lose weight, or boost energy levels, many others report that the side effects they experience far outweigh any benefits. Some individuals have experienced unwanted side effects even at doses considerably below the recommended amount.
mechanism_en:
Yohimbine's primary and most well-studied mechanism of action is antagonism of a class of receptors known as alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, thereby elevating norepinephrine levels by preventing its reuptake by downstream neurons. Blockade of alpha-2 adrenergic receptors raises blood pressure, releases insulin, and lowers blood glucose levels. Yohimbine also blocks alpha-1 adrenergic receptors, albeit with lower affinity. Research has additionally shown that it weakly inhibits monoamine oxidase.

At higher concentrations, yohimbine acts as an antagonist at dopamine D2 and D3 receptors, serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, and 5-HT2A receptors, and as a partial agonist at 5-HT1A receptors.

title: 胞磷胆碱
description:
胞磷胆碱（CDP-胆碱、胞苷5'-二磷酸胆碱）是一种水溶性营养素，可在脑内作为胆碱和胞苷的前体（后者随后会转化为尿苷）呢。对人类而言，胆碱是一种必需营养素，因为它在降低神经管缺陷、脂肪肝和其他病理状态风险方面的作用已经有文献记载。CDP-胆碱是三种可经口补充的含胆碱磷脂之一（另外两种是Alpha-GPC和磷脂酰胆碱）。

这种补充剂主要面向预防或治疗与衰老相关的记忆损害，因为它所提供的两种分子都具有神经保护作用，并且可能增强学习能力。这种效应对较年轻的人群也可能有帮助哦。看起来在这一用途上，它比磷脂酰胆碱（PC）本身更高效，部分原因在于它还能增加脑内 PC 的合成。

胞磷胆碱也被用于认知障碍的治疗，例如由中风、血管性痴呆、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等引起的认知障碍。

这种化合物的效力与Alpha-GPC有些接近。有一项研究指出，低剂量的 CDP-胆碱会提升注意力（不过这一结果仍需要重复验证），而且 CDP-胆碱也可能具有抗成瘾作用，不仅针对可卡因，初步证据还提示它对食物也可能有一定作用呢。

当作为补充剂服用时，这种化合物具有益智药效应。它相当容易获得，也常被通过网络补充剂商家销售用于这一目的。
mechanism:
CDP-胆碱会分解成两个关键成分：胆碱和胞苷。胆碱及其代谢物主要用于三类重要的生理用途：维持细胞膜的结构完整性、参与细胞膜信号传导，以及参与胆碱能神经传递（即乙酰胆碱的合成）。这一过程本质上会让乙酰胆碱积累到比原本更高的水平。由于乙酰胆碱参与记忆功能，这也许可以部分解释它的益智药效应呢。

胞苷是第二种代谢产物，它是合成尿苷过程中的关键一步，而尿苷会提高磷脂酰胆碱的合成效率。补充尿苷似乎还会增强被激活神经元释放多巴胺的能力，同时又不会明显影响基础多巴胺水平。这或许可以解释它在长期补充后，对空间短时记忆、识别、回忆、注意力以及执行功能的改善作用嘛。
description_en:
Citicoline (CDP-choline, cytidine 5'-diphosphocholine) is a water soluble nutrient which serves as a precursor to both choline and cytidine  within the brain  (which later converts to uridine). To humans, choline is an essential nutrient as its role in reducing the risk of neural tube defects, fatty liver disease, and other pathologies have been documented. CDP-choline is one of the three choline-containing phospholipids that can be orally supplemented (the other two being alpha-GPC and phosphatidylcholine).
This supplement is catered towards preventing or treating memory impairments associated with aging because both of the molecules it confers are neuroprotective and potentially enhance learning. This effect may also benefit younger populations as well. It appears to be more efficient than phosphatidylcholine (PC) itself in this role, in part due to also increasing PC synthesis in the brain. 
Citicoline has also been implicated in the treatments of cognitive impairments, caused by stroke, vascular dementia, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, and more. 
The potency of this compound is somewhat comparable to that of alpha-GPC. One study has noted an increase in attention with low dose CDP-choline (which needs to be replicated), and CDP-choline may have roles as an anti-addictive compound against both cocaine and (preliminary evidence suggests) food as well.
When taken as a supplement, this compound has nootropic effects. It is readily available and commonly sold for this purpose through the use of online supplement vendors.
mechanism_en:
CDP-choline breaks down into two key components: choline and cytidine. Choline and its metabolites are primarily used for three important physiological purposes: maintaining the structural integrity of cell membranes, participating in cell membrane signaling, and supporting cholinergic neurotransmission (i.e., the synthesis of acetylcholine). This process essentially allows acetylcholine to accumulate to higher levels than would otherwise occur. Because acetylcholine is involved in memory function, this may partly explain the compound's nootropic effects.

Cytidine is the second metabolite and is a key intermediate in the synthesis of uridine, which in turn increases the efficiency of phosphatidylcholine synthesis. Uridine supplementation also appears to enhance dopamine release from activated neurons without meaningfully affecting baseline dopamine levels. This may explain the improvements in spatial short-term memory, recognition, recall, attention, and executive function observed with long-term supplementation.

title: 致幻仙人掌
description: 许多不同属的仙人掌都会产生数量不等的麦斯卡林及类似的苯乙胺类物质。具有人类使用历史的仙人掌包括佩奥特（Lophophora williamsii）、圣佩德罗仙人掌（Trichocereus/Echinopsis pachanoi）、秘鲁火炬仙人掌（Trichocereus peruvianus/Echinopsis peruviana）、玻利维亚火炬仙人掌（Trichocereus bridgesii/Echinopsis lageniformis），以及Trichocereus/Echinopsis scopulicola。其他常见仙人掌中也可能含有痕量的麦斯卡林。麦斯卡林及其他生物碱的浓度在不同物种之间、乃至同一物种的不同个体之间都会有相当明显的差异。迷幻仙人掌中发现的其他生物碱还包括 3,4-二甲氧基苯乙胺、4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯乙胺、3-羟基-4,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺、4-羟基-3,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺、安哈洛尼定、安哈利宁、大麦芽碱、酪胺，以及 3-甲氧基酪胺。仙人掌绿色的表皮层中含有大部分精神活性生物碱。
description_en: Many cacti belonging to different genera produce varying quantities of mescaline and related phenethylamine compounds. Cacti with a documented history of human use include peyote (Lophophora williamsii), San Pedro cactus (Trichocereus/Echinopsis pachanoi), Peruvian torch cactus (Trichocereus peruvianus/Echinopsis peruviana), Bolivian torch cactus (Trichocereus bridgesii/Echinopsis lageniformis), and Trichocereus/Echinopsis scopulicola. Other common cacti may also contain trace amounts of mescaline. The concentration of mescaline and other alkaloids varies considerably between species and even among individual specimens of the same species. Other alkaloids found in psychedelic cacti include 3,4-dimethoxyphenethylamine, 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenethylamine, 3-hydroxy-4,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, anhalonidine, anhalonine, hordenine, tyramine, and 3-methoxytyramine. The green outer layer of the cactus contains the majority of the psychoactive alkaloids.

title: 舒芬太尼
description: 舒芬太尼，也被称为舒芬太尼，商品名为舒芬塔，是一种效力极强的合成苯胺基哌啶类物质阿片类药物镇痛药。舒芬太尼起效迅速，作用时程较短，医学上会将其用作外科手术中的镇痛药，或用于术后疼痛管理呢。舒芬太尼的效力大约是药用级吗啡的500至1000倍，也大约是药用级芬太尼的10倍。舒芬太尼的主观效应与海洛因相似，不过有不少使用者报告说，与这种药物相关的躯体欣快感明显更弱，而呼吸抑制、镇静和镇痛则更强。舒芬太尼是目前人类医学中使用的效力最强的阿片类镇痛药。
description_en: Sufentanil, also known as sufentanyl and by the brand name Sufenta, is an extremely potent synthetic anilidopiperidine opioid analgesic. Sufentanil has a rapid onset and short mechanism and is used medically as an analgesic in surgical procedures or for the management of post-operative pain. Sufentanil is roughly 500 to 1,000 times more potent than pharmaceutical grade morphine and is approximately 10 times more potent than pharmaceutical grade fentanyl. The subjective effects of sufentanil are similar to those of heroin, with the exception that many users report a significantly less euphoric "high" associated with the drug and stronger respiratory depression, sedation and pain relief. Sufentanil is the most potent opioid analgesic currently used in human medicine.

title: 艾捉菲尼
description:
艾捉菲尼（也称为 Olmifon）是莫达菲尼的前体药物——一种具有益智效果的觉醒剂（eugeroic）呢。艾捉菲尼在肝脏中代谢生成莫达菲尼。两者都是兴奋剂，但不具有类似苯丙胺的效果哦。关于艾捉菲尼的安全性信息比较缺乏，因为莫达菲尼通常被用来代替它治疗嗜睡症和日间过度嗜睡嘛。

不建议长期补充艾捉菲尼，因为它会在肝脏中代谢成莫达菲尼，长期使用可能会导致肝酶升高，给肝脏带来压力呢。

![莫达菲尼与艾捉菲尼结构对比](/文件/Modafinil_vs_adrafinil.png)

艾捉菲尼化学结构 vs. 莫达菲尼

艾捉菲尼在结构上与其近亲化学物质及生物活性代谢产物莫达菲尼非常相似哦。唯一的结构区别在于，艾捉菲尼（(二苯甲基)亚磺酰基-2-乙酰异羟肟酸）末端的酰胺羟基在莫达菲尼（(二苯甲基)亚磺酰基-2-乙酰胺）中是不存在的[[1]](#cite_note-1)。
description_en: Adrafinil (also known as Olmifon) is a prodrug for modafinil - a wakefulness-promoting agent (eugeroic) with nootropic effects. Adrafinil is metabolized in the liver to produce modafinil. Both are stimulants with no amphetamine-like effects. Safety information on adrafinil is lacking because modafinil is often used instead, for treatment of narcolepsy and excessive daytime sleepiness. Long-term supplementation of adrafinil is not advised, since adrafinil is metabolized into modafinil in the liver, and may stress the liver through elevated liver enzymes with prolonged use.

title: 艾斯卡林
description:
3,5-二甲氧基-4-乙氧基苯乙胺（通常被称为 艾斯卡林）是一种苯乙胺化学类别的合成迷幻剂，在给药后会产生迷幻效应呢。它是麦斯卡林的密切相关结构类似物，与之共享许多共同特性喵。

艾斯卡林最初由 Benington 等人在 1954 年合成并在科学文献中报道，但后来在 大卫·尼科尔斯 的实验室中被重新研究。他准备了一系列麦斯卡林类似物，包括 普罗斯卡林、吉姆斯卡林、异普罗斯卡林 等等。

艾斯卡林的效应最初由 亚历山大·舒尔金 在他的书 PiHKAL 中描述。他列出的口服剂量范围为 40 mg 到 60 mg，并描述药效时长为 8-12 小时。舒尔金指出，艾斯卡林“与麦斯卡林的不同之处在于起效更快（在第一个小时内），并且没有观察到恶心，但除此之外，时间历程和许多定性内容都非常相似”呢。
mechanism: 艾斯卡林在血清素 5-HT2A 受体上的激动剂活性已知比麦斯卡林强 5-8 倍呢。这种化合物的效应被认为源于它作为部分激动剂在 5-HT 受体 上的效力。然而，这些相互作用如何导致迷幻体验的作用机制目前仍然难以捉摸喵。
description_en:
3,5-Dimethoxy-4-ethoxyphenethylamine (commonly known as Escaline) is a synthetic psychedelic substance of the phenethylamine chemical class that produces psychedelic effects when administered. It is a closely related structural analog of mescaline with which it shares many common properties.
Escaline was first synthesized and reported in the scientific literature by Benington, et al., in 1954, but was later re-examined in the laboratory of David E. Nichols who prepared a series of mescaline analogues, including proscaline, jimscaline, isoproscaline, and others.
The effects of escaline were first described by Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL: A Chemical Love Story. He lists the dosage range as 40 mg to 60 mg orally and describes the duration of action to be 8–12 hours. Shulgin states that escaline “differs from mescaline in that the onset of action is quicker (within the first hour) and there is no nausea noted, but otherwise the time course, and much of the qualitative content, is quite similar.
mechanism_en: Escaline is known to possess agonist activity at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor approximately 5–8 times more potent than that of mescaline. The effects of this compound are believed to derive from its activity as a partial agonist at 5-HT2 receptors. However, the precise mechanism by which these interactions produce the psychedelic experience remains poorly understood.

title: 芬太尼
iupac: N-(1-(2-苯乙基)-4-哌啶基)-N-苯基丙酰胺
description:
芬太尼是一种效力极强的阿片类药物，属于苯胺基哌啶类物质。它是μ-阿片受体的强激动剂，效力大约是医药级（即 100% 纯）海洛因的 40 到 50 倍，更是吗啡的 80 到 100 倍左右呢。

目前有各种各样的芬太尼制剂，包括透皮贴剂、棒棒糖、口腔含片或贴片、鼻喷雾剂和吸入器。在街头，它通常以粉末形式出现，经常被掺入海洛因或其他药物中销售，这已经导致了无数的意外过量和死亡事件。在 2016 年，芬太尼及其类似物成为了美国过量死亡最常见的原因。

它的主观效应与海洛因相似，包括镇痛、镇静、呼吸抑制和认知欣快。不过，相对于其他阿片类药物，它的药效发作极快且总时长较短，这可能会导致强迫性补量哦。此外，许多用户反映芬太尼及其类似物的认知欣快感明显较少。因此，大家普遍认为它的娱乐价值比较低呢。

芬太尼是一种非常危险的物质，因为它具有成瘾性，而且由于效力惊人，很难安全地控制剂量。如果选择使用芬太尼，一定要意识到自己正处于极高的风险之中。强烈建议采取伤害减少措施，并使用试剂检测套件对所有阿片类药物进行检测，看看有没有掺杂芬太尼哦。
mechanism:
芬太尼之所以产生娱乐效应，是因为阿片类药物在结构上模拟了人体内自然存在的内源性内啡肽，并作用于 μ-阿片受体组。这种模拟会导致躯体欣快感、镇痛和焦虑抑制效应。这是因为内啡肽负责减轻疼痛、诱导睡眠和产生愉悦感。

芬太尼与吗啡相比效力极强，主要是由于其极高的亲脂性。正因为如此，它比其他阿片类药物更容易穿透中枢神经系统喵。
description_en:
Fentanyl (also known as Fentanil and by the brand names Sublimaze, Actiq, Durogesic, Duragesic, Fentora, Matrifen, Haldid, Onsolis, Instanyl, Abstral, Lazanda among others) is a potent opioid substance of the anilidopiperidine class. It is a strong agonist at the μ-opioid receptors and approximately 40 to 50 times more potent than pharmaceutical grade (i.e. 100% pure) heroin and roughly 80 to 100 times more potent than morphine. 
A wide range of pharmaceutical fentanyl preparations are available, including transdermal skin patches, lollipops, buccal tablets or patches, nasal sprays, and inhalers. On the street, it is typically encountered in powder form, where it is often cut into or sold as heroin and other drugs, which has resulted in numerous accidental overdoses and fatalities. In 2016, fentanyl and analogues were the most common cause of overdose deaths in the United States at more than 20,000, about half of all opioid-related deaths.
Subjective effects are similar to those of heroin and includes pain relief (analgesia), sedation, respiratory depression, and euphoria. However, it has a rapid onset and short duration of action relative to other opioids, which can lead to compulsive redosing. Additionally, many users report noticeably less euphoria with fentanyl and its analogs. As a result, it is generally considered to have lower recreational value. 
Fentanyl is a highly dangerous substance due its addictiveness and the difficulty with which it can be safely dosed, a result of its incredible potency. Users are advised to be aware of the extreme risk they are placing themselves in if they choose to use fentanyl. It is also highly advised to use harm reduction practices if a user chooses to do fentanyl. Users are also advised to test all of their opioids (and substances in general) for fentanyl and other adulterants using reagent testing kits.
mechanism_en:
Fentanyl produces its recreational effects because opioids structurally mimic endogenous endorphins that occur naturally in the body and act on the μ-opioid receptor group. This mimicry produces physical euphoria, analgesia, and anxiety suppression, as endorphins are responsible for reducing pain, inducing sleep, and producing feelings of pleasure.

Fentanyl's extreme potency relative to morphine is primarily attributable to its high lipophilicity, which allows it to penetrate the central nervous system more readily than other opioids.

title: 芬纳西泮
description:
免责声明：本网站的给药剂量信息仅出于教育目的，汇总自用户与各类资料，并不构成推荐，仍应结合其他来源核实其准确性嘛。

芬纳西泮是一种属于苯二氮卓类物质的抑制剂。其显著效应包括焦虑抑制、去抑制、镇静、肌肉松弛以及失忆。芬纳西泮的街头俗称包括“盆栽”“苏联苯二氮卓”“芬纳兹”和“熊猫”呢。

长期大量使用苯二氮卓类物质的人，若突然停药，可能会引发癫痫发作，而在某些情况下这甚至可能危及生命。因此，通常建议在一段时间内逐步降低每日剂量，而不是突然停用——这种方法被称为减量戒断法。
mechanism:
尽管芬纳西泮相对于剂量而言毒性较低，但它仍具有与苯二氮卓类药物相关的成瘾、过量和戒断风险。此外，该药物在地西泮常规剂量的十分之一左右就能表现出活性。较高剂量的芬纳西泮有时会被用于治疗严重焦虑或癫痫发作。

芬纳西泮是 γ-氨基丁酸 A 型（GABAA）受体的激动剂，并会产生中枢神经系统抑制作用。在雄性大鼠的高架迷宫和冲突试验中，极低剂量的芬纳西泮表现出了抗焦虑效应。常规剂量下，芬纳西泮可作为一种效力很强的镇静安定剂。研究显示，在经过戊巴比妥与生理盐水辨别训练的成年大鼠中，芬纳西泮可以完全替代戊巴比妥。在拮抗试验中，芬纳西泮的辨别效应可被选择性的苯二氮卓类拮抗剂氟马西尼完全拮抗。芬纳西泮的半衰期最长可达 60 小时，口服后的效应起始时间大约为 2-3 小时；正因如此，使用者在尚未观察到其效应前就提前补量的风险会更高。芬纳西泮的代谢产物 3-羟基芬纳西泮同样也是 GABAA 受体激动剂。以上药代动力学数据提示，芬纳西泮具有较高的过量潜力。
description_en:
Disclaimer: The dosage information on this website has been compiled from user reports and other resources for educational purposes only, does not constitute a recommendation, and should be verified against additional sources.

Phenazepam is a depressant of the benzodiazepine class. Its notable effects include anxiety suppression, disinhibition, sedation, muscle relaxation, and amnesia. Street names for phenazepam include "bonsai," "Soviet benzo," "fenaz," and "pandas."

Individuals who use benzodiazepines heavily over a prolonged period may experience seizures upon abrupt discontinuation, which in some cases can be life-threatening. Gradual dose tapering over a period of time—rather than abrupt cessation—is therefore generally recommended.
mechanism_en:
Although phenazepam has relatively low toxicity relative to dose, it carries the risks of dependence, overdose, and withdrawal associated with the benzodiazepine class. Furthermore, the drug is active at approximately one-tenth of a typical diazepam dose. Higher doses of phenazepam are sometimes used to manage severe anxiety or seizures.

Phenazepam is an agonist at the GABA-A (GABAA) receptor and produces central nervous system depressant effects. In elevated-plus maze and conflict tests in male rats, extremely low doses of phenazepam demonstrated anxiolytic effects. At standard doses, phenazepam functions as a potent sedative-hypnotic. Studies have shown that phenazepam fully substitutes for pentobarbital in adult rats trained to discriminate pentobarbital from saline. In antagonism studies, phenazepam's discriminative effects are completely blocked by the selective benzodiazepine antagonist flumazenil. Phenazepam has a half-life of up to 60 hours and an oral onset of approximately 2–3 hours; as a result, users face an elevated risk of redosing before the effects have become apparent. The primary metabolite of phenazepam, 3-hydroxyphenazepam, is also a GABAA receptor agonist. These pharmacokinetic parameters indicate that phenazepam carries a high overdose potential.

title: 苄达明
description:
免责声明：本网站的给药剂量信息整理自用户与相关资料，仅供教育用途，并不构成推荐呢。使用前还请结合其他来源核实其准确性哦。

相互作用

苄达明（也称特快灵或坦图姆维德）是一种属于吲唑类物质的局部麻醉剂。它有时会以小剂量出现在用于治疗咽喉疼痛的非处方产品中。在德国、阿拉伯国家和波兰，它还会以坦图姆罗莎这一商品名作为阴道冲洗剂出售。这类产品也可以通过 eBay 等网店在世界各地较容易地购得呢。

此外，苄达明也可以作为一种强效精神活性致幻剂被娱乐性使用。在高剂量下，它会表现为一种独特的谵妄剂以及中枢神经系统兴奋剂。这种用法，尤其是在青少年群体中，已在波兰、巴西和罗马尼亚被报道过。
mechanism:
苄达明是一种局部起效的非甾体抗炎药，具有局部麻醉和镇痛特性。与其他 NSAID 不同的是，它不会抑制环氧合酶或脂氧合酶，也不具有致溃疡性。

至于其致幻性效应背后的药理机制，目前仍未被研究清楚，因此这一部分还存在相当多推测呢。

苄达明具有很强的强化效应，而且这一效应在已有物质使用经验的动物中会显著增强，尤其是在这些动物先前已自行给药海洛因和可卡因之后更是如此，这表明苄达明与其他常见滥用药物之间可能存在交叉敏化。苄达明会以剂量依赖的方式同时降低场兴奋性突触后电位振幅与成对脉冲比值，这提示其可能具有突触前作用机制。与体内实验模型类似，曾经历可卡因和海洛因自我给药的动物，其脑片中的苄达明电生理效应同样会被增强。此外，在前额叶前边缘皮层至伏隔核回路中，苄达明所诱导的类长时程抑制（LTD）反应，在CB1受体拮抗剂 AM251 存在时会显著减弱。这些发现为苄达明具有滥用潜力提供了有力证据，并提示其可能具有一种大麻素能作用机制。
description_en:
Benzydamine (also known as Difflam or Tantum Verde) is a topical anaesthetic of the indazole chemical class. It is sometimes found in small doses in over-the-counter products used to treat sore throats. In Germany, Arabic Countries and Poland, it is sold as a vaginal douching agent under the brand name Tantum Rosa. This product is also easily accessible  across the world through the use of online stores such as eBay.
Alternatively, benzydamine can be used as a powerful psychoactive hallucinogen for recreational purposes. In high doses, it acts as a unique deliriant and CNS stimulant. Such use, particularly among teenagers, has been reported in Poland, Brazil and Romania.
mechanism_en:
Benzydamine is a locally acting non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug with local anesthetic and analgesic properties. Unlike other NSAIDs, it does not inhibit cyclooxygenase or lipoxygenase enzymes and is non-ulcerogenic.

The pharmacological mechanism underlying its hallucinogenic effects has not been adequately studied and this area remains largely speculative.

Benzydamine has strong reinforcing properties, and these properties are significantly enhanced in animals with prior substance use experience—particularly in animals that have previously self-administered heroin and cocaine—suggesting the possibility of cross-sensitization between benzydamine and other commonly abused drugs. Benzydamine dose-dependently decreases both field excitatory postsynaptic potential amplitude and paired-pulse ratio, indicating a possible presynaptic mechanism of action. Consistent with in vivo models, the electrophysiological effects of benzydamine in brain slices from animals with prior cocaine and heroin self-administration history are similarly potentiated. Furthermore, benzydamine-induced long-term depression (LTD)-like responses in the infralimbic prefrontal cortex-to-nucleus accumbens circuit are significantly attenuated in the presence of the CB1 receptor antagonist AM251. These findings provide strong evidence for benzydamine's abuse potential and suggest a possible cannabinoid mechanism of action.

title: 苏摩
description:
苏摩（亦称豪麻）是印伊人早期，以及后来的大印度与大伊朗文化中一种重要的精神活性仪式饮品。文献描述它是通过提取某种植物的汁液制成的，而这种植物的具体身份如今仍然未知，学界对此也仍有争议。在印度教和琐罗亚斯德教中，这种饮品与该植物共用同一个名称，并且也被人格化为一位神祇。

关于原始植物究竟是什么，学界已经提出了许多推测。目前这一问题尚无共识，不过一些被提出的候选者包括毒蝇伞、古巴裸盖菇、骆驼蓬和草麻黄。
description_en:
Soma (also known as haoma) was an important psychoactive ritual drink used in early Indo-Iranian culture and, subsequently, in the greater Indic and Iranian traditions. Ancient texts describe it as prepared by extracting the juice of a particular plant, the precise identity of which remains unknown and is still debated among scholars. In both Hinduism and Zoroastrianism, the drink and the plant share the same name and are also personified as a deity.

Numerous hypotheses have been proposed regarding what the original plant may have been. No consensus exists on this question, though some of the candidates that have been put forward include Amanita muscaria, Psilocybe cubensis, Peganum harmala, and Ephedra sinica.

title: 苦茶碱
description:
苦茶碱（也称为 Teacrine）是一种益智药性质的兴奋剂，也是咖啡因的结构类似物，似乎在某些植物中是由咖啡因合成的喵。它是一种苦味的白色结晶[嘌呤生物碱]，可以增加大脑活动并诱发暂时的改善，包括增强警觉性、清醒和兴奋呢。相对于咖啡因，它在产生的刺激感方面表现出约三分之二的效力哦。

苦茶碱的机制与咖啡因很大程度上平行，因为它在啮齿动物中似乎具有刺激作用，但这仅在较高剂量下发生（苦茶碱达到峰值的确切口服剂量尚不清楚）。与咖啡因类似，它在相对较低的剂量下会产生镇静效果，但咖啡因的这种镇静效果出现在极低且不切实际的剂量下，而苦茶碱的镇静剂量则是苦茶（Kucha tea）通常消耗的剂量喵；这可能就是为什么苦茶往往被推荐用于放松而非刺激的原因呢。

目录

+ 3.1 躯体效应 + 3.2 认知效应 + 4.1 耐受性与成瘾潜力

化学
description_en:
Theacrine (also known as Teacrine) is a nootropic stimulant and structural analog of caffeine that appears to be biosynthesized from caffeine in certain plants. It is a bitter white crystalline purine alkaloid that increases brain activity and produces temporary improvements including enhanced alertness, wakefulness, and stimulation. Relative to caffeine, it exhibits approximately two-thirds of its potency in producing stimulant effects.

Theacrine's mechanism closely parallels that of caffeine, as it appears to produce stimulant effects in rodents, though this occurs only at higher doses (the precise oral dose at which theacrine reaches peak stimulant effect has not been established). Similar to caffeine, it produces sedation at relatively low doses, though caffeine's sedating dose range is extremely low and impractical, whereas theacrine's sedating dose corresponds to the amount typically consumed in kucha tea; this may explain why kucha tea is often recommended for relaxation rather than stimulation.

title: 苯丙胺
description:
苯丙胺（也称为 alpha-甲基苯乙胺、amfetamine、安非他命、思必得，或商品名包括 Adderall、Dexedrine 和 Tentin）是苯乙胺类物质中的经典兴奋剂物质。

它是取代苯丙胺类物质的母体化合物，这是一个多样化的群体，包括甲基苯丙胺、MDMA、卡西酮和安非他酮。其作用机制涉及促进神经递质多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素的释放。

它最初于 1887 年合成，但直到 1929 年才发现其精神兴奋作用。 在 20 世纪 30 年代，它以「Benzedrine」的名字作为减充血剂在柜台销售。 它曾被广泛用于治疗酒精宿醉、发作性睡病、抑郁症和肥胖症等一系列疾病。 由于成瘾和滥用问题，它最终被列入联合国 1971 年《精神药物公约》的管制物质清单。

苯丙胺现在主要是一种处方药，用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍 (ADHD)、发作性睡病和肥胖症。  与其他兴奋剂一样，苯丙胺治疗可能与 ADHD 患者的神经保护有关，因为它减少了通常与未经治疗的 ADHD 受试者神经缺陷相关的神经递质缺乏。  此外，它还被广泛非法用作体能增强剂和娱乐性物质。

主观效应包括兴奋、专注力强化、动机增强、性欲增强、食欲抑制和欣快感。它通常通过口服摄入，但也可以鼻吸、注射或直肠给药。较低剂量倾向于提高专注力和生产力，而较高剂量倾向于增加社交能力、性欲和欣快感。
mechanism:
苯丙胺通过增加大脑奖励和执行功能通路中神经递质 去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺的信号传导活性来发挥其行为效应。苯丙胺的强化和动机作用主要是由于中脑边缘通路中多巴胺能活性的增强。

苯丙胺的欣快和运动刺激效应取决于它增加纹状体中突触多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素浓度的程度和速度。

它是微量胺相关受体 1 (TAAR1) 的强效全激动剂，并与囊泡单胺转运蛋白 2 (VMAT2) 相互作用。   对 TAAR1 和 VMAT2 的联合作用导致突触中多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素浓度增加，从而刺激神经元活动。

右旋苯丙胺是比左旋苯丙胺更强效的 TAAR1 激动剂。 因此，右旋苯丙胺产生的中枢神经系统刺激比左旋苯丙胺大，大约多出三到四倍，但左旋苯丙胺具有稍强的心血管和外周效应。

苯丙胺的确切生物利用度尚不清楚，但据信口服超过 75%，注射或鼻吸更高。 其吸收和排泄可能取决于 pH 值。碱性形式更容易在肠道吸收，更不容易被肾脏移除，可能会增加其半衰期。 它由肾脏通过排泄移除，少量由肝酶移除。
description_en:
Amphetamine (also known as alpha-methylphenethylamine, amfetamine, speed, or by brand names including Adderall, Dexedrine and Tentin) is a classical stimulant substance of the phenethylamine class. 
It is the parent compound of the substituted amphetamines, a diverse group that includes methamphetamine, MDMA, cathinone, and bupropion. The mechanism of action involves promoting release of the neurotransmitters dopamine and norepinephrine.
It was first synthesized in 1887, but its psychostimulant effects were not discovered until 1929. In the 1930s, it was sold over-the-counter under the name "Benzedrine" as a decongestant. It became widely used to treat a range of ailments such as alcohol hangover, narcolepsy, depression, and obesity. Due to issues with addiction and abuse, it was eventually listed as a controlled substance under the United Nations 1971 "Convention on Psychotropic Substances".
Amphetamine is now primarily a prescription drug used to treat attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), narcolepsy, and obesity. Treatment with Amphetamine, among other stimulants, may be associated with neuroprotection for ADHD patients by reducing neurotransmitter deficiencies commonly linked to neurological deficits within untreated subjects with ADHD. Additionally, it sees widespread illicit use as a performance enhancing agent and recreational substance.
Subjective effects include stimulation, focus enhancement, motivation enhancement, increased libido, appetite suppression, and euphoria. It is usually taken orally, but can also be insufflated, injected, or administered rectally. Lower doses tend to increase focus and productivity while higher doses tend to increase sociability, sexual desire, and euphoria. 
Amphetamine has high abuse potential. Chronic use (i.e. high dose, repeat administration) is associated with compulsive redosing, escalating tolerance, and psychological dependence. Additionally, abuse has been linked to a number of health conditions, especially cardiovascular issues such as high blood pressure and increased risk of stroke. 
It is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.

title: 苯基吡拉西坦
description:
苯基吡拉西坦（亦称 Phenotropil 和 Carphedon）是一种属于拉西坦类药物的中枢神经系统兴奋剂和益智药。 虽然它是最早合成和记录的吡拉西坦衍生物之一，但对其在人类身上的特性和功效的研究是有限的。

苯基吡拉西坦在美国作为膳食补充剂通过在线供应商销售，很容易获得。通常报告的剂量约为 Noopept 的 12 倍，这使得它效力较低，但提供了类似的益处。

苯基吡拉西坦的补充剂量通常在一天 100 ~ 300 毫克的范围内， 分为两到三个均匀分布的给药期（例如三次 100 mg 或 200 mg 的剂量）。

在鼠类种群中，苯基吡拉西坦已被证明可以防止东莨菪碱诱导的健忘症，这表明它可以通过保持足够的乙酰胆碱水平作为主要机制，帮助从谵妄剂中毒和其他典型的认知受损状态中恢复。

许多人报告说，苯基吡拉西坦的效果（特别是刺激作用）比其他拉西坦类药物更明显。这可能是由于苯基吡拉西坦作为多巴胺再摄取抑制剂和去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂的作用。
mechanism:
苯基吡拉西坦被认为会增加海马细胞内的乙酰胆碱释放。 由于乙酰胆碱参与记忆功能，这可能解释了其报告的益智药效应。

苯基吡拉西坦似乎进行了一系列试验，显示出对器质性原因导致的认知衰退患者的认知改善，其中一项研究指出青少年癫痫患者的认知有轻微改善。
description_en:
Phenylpiracetam (also known as Phenotropil and Carphedon) is a central nervous system stimulant and nootropic agent belonging to the racetam family of drugs. Although it is one of the first derivatives of piracetam to be synthesized and documented, research into its properties and efficacy in humans is limited.
Phenylpiracetam is readily available and sold through online vendors as a dietary supplement in the United States. Dosages are commonly reported to be around nearly twelve times those of noopept, making it less potent while offering comparable benefit.
Supplementation of phenylpiracetam tends to be in the dosage range of 100 - 300 mg taken over the course of a day, either in two to three evenly spread dosing periods (such as three doses of 100mg or 200mg).
Phenylpiracetam has protected against scopolamine-induced amnesia both in rat populations, suggesting it can aid recovery from deliriant intoxication and other typically cognitively impaired states by preserving adequate levels of acetylcholine as a primary mechanism.
Many people report that phenylpiracetam effects (especially stimulation) are more pronounced than other racetams. That may be due phenypiracetam's action as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor and noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor.

title: 苯巴比妥
description:
当巴比妥类药物与抑制剂（如阿片类药物、苯二氮卓类药物、加巴喷丁类药物、噻吩二氮卓类药物、酒精或其他GABA能物质）联用时，可能会导致死亡。[[1]](#cite_note-tripsit-1)

强烈建议不要同时服用中等至严重剂量的这些物质。

请勿与戊巴比妥混淆。

苯巴比妥（Phenobarbital，英式英语中也称为 phenobarbitone，商品名为 鲁米那 (Luminal)）是一种长效的巴比妥类精神活性药物，具有强大的抗焦虑、催眠、肌肉松弛和遗忘效应。苯巴比妥在医学上用作抗惊厥药，偶尔也用于短期治疗失眠。苯巴比妥的作用方式与苯二氮卓类药物相似，但巴比妥类药物结合于GABA-A受体上一个独特的变构位点。

与其他巴比妥类药物（如戊巴比妥）相比，苯巴比妥的消除极慢且作用持续时间长，类似于地西泮，这使其成为治疗癫痫的理想选择。
description_en:
Phenobarbital, also known as phenobarbitone in British English and by the brand name Luminal, is a long-acting psychoactive drug of the barbiturate class which produces powerful anxiolytic, hypnotic, muscle relaxant and amnesic effects. Phenobarbital is used medically as an anticonvulsant, and occasionally in the short term treatment of insomnia. Phenobarbital works in a similar fashion to benzodiazepines, however barbiturates bind to a distinct allosteric site on the GABAA receptor.
Compared to other barbiturates such as pentobarbital, phenobarbital has an extremely slow elimination and long duration of action, similar to diazepam, which makes it ideal for the treatment of epilepsy.
Phenobarbital, like most long-acting barbiturates, can be deemed moderately addictive. The abrupt discontinuation of phenobarbital in dependent individuals may be life-threatening and lead to seizures and even death. Phenobarbital drastically enhances the effects of other depressants such as alcohol, and concurrent use may lead to respiratory depression and possibly death.
According to many sources, it is substantially more powerful than sister-substances pentobarbital or secobarbital'', with a dosage convertion ratio of 1:3 in order to achieve equal depressant effects. The product is nonetheless consumed in very high doses as an anti-epileptic substance, as is also clonazepam, which has largely replaced phenobarbital in this context.

title: 苯海拉明
description:
苯海拉明（也被称为 DPH、Dimedrol、Benadryl等）是乙醇胺类的一种谵妄剂物质。它是第一代H1抗组胺药，作为非处方药广泛用于治疗过敏。当超过批准剂量时，苯海拉明会产生强大的谵妄效果呢。

苯海拉明最早于1943年合成。1946年，它成为美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的第一个处方抗组胺药。它在1980年代被批准为非处方药使用。[[1]](#cite_note-Emanuel-1) 今天，它通常用于治疗过敏，但也可能用于多种病症，包括瘙痒、失眠、晕动病、恶心和帕金森病的症状。[[2]](#cite_note-2)

主观效应包括镇静、焦虑、触觉幻觉、记忆抑制、思维混乱、认知不快和外部幻觉。较低剂量倾向于产生一种类似大麻的身体沉重感，而较高剂量会产生谵妄状态，使用者会看到和听到完全成形、令人信服的幻觉。介于这两者之间的剂量通常是不舒服和令人不快的。

值得注意的是，经常有报告称它会产生显著的恶心和身体不适（“身体负荷”）。大多数尝试苯海拉明的人并没有报告积极的效果，也不希望重复这种体验呢。

由于其令人不快的效果，通常认为它的滥用潜力较低。娱乐性使用的毒性尚未得到充分研究。轶事报告表明，长期使用（即高剂量、重复给药）可能会导致持续的幻觉以及认知和记忆障碍。高剂量也与癫痫发作和心脏毒性有关。[[3]](#cite_note-3)
mechanism:
苯海拉明是外周组胺H1受体和中枢组胺H1受体的受体逆向激动剂。外周逆向激动作用诱导了过敏缓解效果。像许多第一代抗组胺药一样，它也是mACH受体的竞争性拮抗剂。

苯海拉明是一种乙酰胆碱受体拮抗剂。虽然确切的机制尚不清楚，但抑制乙酰胆碱的作用被认为是导致谵妄、镇静和极其逼真的幻觉以及极度不适和令人不快的身体副作用的主要原因。

苯海拉明已被证明能阻断钠通道并抑制血清素的再摄取。[[7]](#cite_note-Domino_1999-7) 它还能阻断电压门控钾通道（VGKCs），这意味着它有可能导致或引起尖端扭转性室速，这是一种潜在危险的心脏状况，可能导致心源性猝死。[[9]](#cite_note-9)

受体结合亲和力如下表所示：[[10]](#cite_note-Kim2000-10)[[7]](#cite_note-Domino_1999-7)
description_en:
Diphenhydramine (also known as DPH, Dimedrol, Benadryl, and many others) is a deliriant substance of the ethanolamine class. 
It is a first-generation H1 antihistamine that is widely used as a generic, over-the-counter medication to treat allergies. 
When exceeding approved doses, diphenhydramine produces powerful deliriant effects.
Diphenhydramine was first synthesized in 1943. 
In 1946, it became the first prescription antihistamine approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. It was approved for over-the-counter use in the 1980s. 
Today, it is typically used to treat allergies, but it may also be used for several conditions, including itchiness, insomnia, motion sickness, nausea, and the symptoms of Parkinson's disease. 
Subjective effects include sedation, anxiety, tactile hallucinations, memory suppression, thought disorganization, dysphoria, and external hallucinations. Lower doses tend to produce a stoning, body-high effect, while higher doses produce a state of delirium in which the user sees and hears fully-formed, compelling hallucinations. Doses between these two points are uncomfortable and dysphoric. 
Notably, it is frequently reported to produce significant nausea and bodily discomfort ("body load"). Most people who try diphenhydramine do not report positive effects and do not wish to repeat the experience.
It is generally considered to have low abuse potential due to its dysphoric effects. The toxicity of recreational use is not well-studied. Anecdotal reports suggest that chronic use (i.e., high dose, repeated administration) may cause persisting hallucinations and impairments in cognition & memory. High doses have also been linked to seizures and cardiotoxicity.
It is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.

title: 苯海索
description:
苯海索于1949年在美国首次临床应用并获批，原作为抗帕金森病药物，源于早期颠茄碱类治疗震颤麻痹的延续。20世纪中叶广泛用于药物诱发锥体外系反应（EPS）矫正，尤其伴随经典抗精神病药使用。2003年FDA扩展适应症至各类帕金森综合征。目前为处方药，在精神科及神经科常见，但因中枢抗胆碱效应引发的欣快及幻觉潜力，21世纪以来滥用报告渐增，部分地区视为潜在滥用物质。

药物分类： 谵妄剂（Deliriants）。

药理机制： 苯海索为中枢性毒蕈碱型乙酰胆碱受体（muscarinic acetylcholine receptors）拮抗剂，主要阻断纹状体及皮层M受体，导致胆碱能传导广泛抑制，同时干扰中枢多巴胺再摄取及储存，间接增强多巴胺活性。该拮抗作用在外周较弱（约为阿托品1/10-1/3），但高剂量时中枢效应显著放大，干扰觉醒-注意力网络及记忆通路，产生类似于自然谵妄的脑电模式。口服后快速吸收，1小时起效，持续6-12小时。

服用效果及后果： 医疗剂量下有效缓解震颤、僵直及药物性EPS，主观放松伴轻度情绪抬升。非医疗或超量使用可现短暂欣快、兴奋、社交增强及幻觉（视觉/听觉为主，高度真实性）；伴随口干、瞳孔散大、心悸、视物模糊及定向障碍。高剂量诱发急性谵妄综合征：精神错乱、妄想、交互式幻觉、激动或攻击行为。长期反复摄入导致耐受、心理依赖及撤药反应（焦虑、抑郁、胆碱超敏）。慢性暴露致认知永久缺损、记忆障碍、持久性精神病样症状及外周并发症（尿潴留、便秘）。过量风险包括高热、癫痫、心律失常及循环衰竭，成瘾机制以正性强化及负性逃避为主。
