description_en:
Trihexyphenidyl (THP, Pacitane, Benzhexol, Trihex, Artane, and others) is an anticholinergic substance of the antimuscarinic class used to treat stiffness, tremors, spasms, and poor muscle control. In high doses, it has been reported to act as a psychedelic and deliriant. 
Trihexyphenidyl has been used for the symptomatic treatment of Parkinson's disease as approved by the FDA in the United States since 2003. It is also used for the treatment of drug-induced movement disorders such as essential tremors and akathisia, commonly caused by antipsychotics.

title: 茴拉西坦
description:
茴拉西坦（Draganon、Sarpul、Ampamet、Memodrin、Referan，系统命名为N-茴酰基-2-吡咯烷酮）是一种属于拉西坦类物质家族的益智药。尽管它是已知最早被合成出来的吡拉西坦衍生物之一，但关于它在人类中的研究和实际效力，仍然比较有限呢。

在美国，茴拉西坦可以较容易地通过网络商家以膳食补充剂形式购得和销售。它的剂量通常接近noopept的十五倍，因此效价较低，但能提供大致相近的益处。

茴拉西坦的补充剂用法，通常是在一天内摄入800-2500mg，并分成两到三次均匀服用，例如一天三次，每次400mg或800mg这样子。

茴拉西坦在大鼠和人类中都表现出对东莨菪碱诱发失忆的保护作用，这提示它可能可以通过维持足够的乙酰胆碱水平，来帮助从谵妄剂中毒以及其他通常伴有认知受损的状态中恢复。
mechanism:
茴拉西坦被认为会增加海马细胞内乙酰胆碱的释放。由于乙酰胆碱参与记忆功能，这或许可以解释它的益智药效应。

此外，研究表明茴拉西坦还会调节AMPA受体、GABA能神经传递以及多巴胺能神经传递。
description_en:
Aniracetam  (Draganon, Sarpul, Ampamet, Memodrin, Referan, and systematically as N-anisoyl-2-pyrrolidinone) is a nootropic agent belonging to the racetam family of drugs. Although it is one of the first known and synthesized derivatives of piracetam, its research and efficacy in humans is limited.
Aniracetam is readily available and sold through online vendors as a dietary supplement in the United States. Dosages are nearly fifteen times those of noopept, making it less potent while offering comparable benefit.
Supplementation of aniracetam tends to be in the dosage range of 800-2500mg taken over the course of a day, either in two to three evenly spread dosing periods, such as three doses of 400mg or 800mg.
Aniracetam has protected against scopolamine-induced amnesia both in rat populations and in human populations, suggesting it can aid recovery from deliriant intoxication and other typically cognitively impaired states by preserving adequate levels of acetylcholine as a primary mechanism.

title: 茶氨酸
description:
警告图标：Yellow-warning-sign1.png 此页面尚未经过本站管理人员的完全核准。 它可能包含错误信息，特别是在剂量、时长、主观效应、毒性以及其他风险方面。它可能也不符合本站的格式和语法标准。

L-茶氨酸（也称为茶氨酸、L-γ-谷氨酰乙酰胺和N5-乙基-L-谷氨酰胺）是谷氨酸和谷氨酰胺氨基酸的类似物。它于1949年作为绿茶的一种成分被发现，并于1950年从玉露叶中分离出来，玉露叶含有高含量的茶氨酸。[[2]](#cite_note-2)

如果不带前缀出现“茶氨酸”这一名称，通常理解为暗示L-对映异构体，这是新鲜茶叶和一些（但不是所有）膳食补充剂中存在的形式。相反的D-对映异构体的药理特性研究较少，但存在于外消旋化学制剂中，并且在一些研究过的茶氨酸补充剂中大量存在。

这种化合物被用作益智药，具有镇静和放松的特性。它经常与咖啡因结合使用，因为它已被证明可以减轻咖啡因的负面影响，如焦虑、血压升高和睡眠质量下降，同时可能改善其积极方面。[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4)[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-Kahathuduwa2017-6) 其增强注意力的能力已被反复验证。[[6]](#cite_note-Kahathuduwa2017-6)[[7]](#cite_note-Owen2008-7)[[8]](#cite_note-Haskell2008-8)[[9]](#cite_note-9)[[10]](#cite_note-10)[[11]](#cite_note-11)[[12]](#cite_note-12)

最近一项关于茶氨酸和咖啡因影响的系统评价证实，这种组合似乎能改善注意力的各个方面。[[13]](#cite_note-13) L-茶氨酸和咖啡因的组合可能比单用咖啡因更能提高注意力。[[7]](#cite_note-Owen2008-7)[[8]](#cite_note-Haskell2008-8)
description_en:
L-Theanine (also known as Theanine, L-γ-glutamylethylamide and N5-ethyl-L-glutamine) is an analog of the amino acids of glutamate and glutamine. It was discovered as a constituent of green tea in 1949 and in 1950 was isolated from gyokuro leaves, which have high theanine content. 
The appearance of the name "theanine" without a prefix is understood to imply the L-enantiomer, which is the form found in fresh teas and in some, but not all dietary supplements. The opposite D-enantiomer has far less studied pharmacologic properties, but is present in racemic chemical preparations, and substantially in some studied theanine supplements.
This compound is used as a nootropic for its calming and relaxing properties. It is often taken in combination with caffeine as it has been shown to mitigate its negative aspects, such as anxiety, increased blood pressure and diminished sleep quality, while possibly improving upon the positive aspects. Its ability to enhance attention has been repeatedly verified.
A recent systematic review of the effects of theanine and caffeine has confirmed that the combination seems to improve aspects of attention. The combination of L-theanine and caffeine may improve attention more than caffeine alone.

title: 茶苯海明
description: 茶苯海明系苯海拉明与8-氯茶碱的复合盐，后者为咖啡因衍生物，据报道无法透过血脑屏障，其中苯海拉明约占53-55.5%的总质量，因此茶苯海明预计效力为苯海拉明的53-55.5%。
description_en: Dimenhydrinate is a compound salt of diphenhydramine and 8-chlorotheophylline, the latter being a caffeine derivative reported to be unable to cross the blood-brain barrier. Diphenhydramine comprises approximately 53–55.5% of the total mass of dimenhydrinate; accordingly, dimenhydrinate is expected to be approximately 53–55.5% as potent as diphenhydramine.

title: 莫达菲尼
description:
莫达非尼（也以商品名 Provigil、Alertec、Modavigil 等为人所知）是一种二苯甲基类物质的促醒剂物质，使用后会产生促进觉醒和兴奋剂效应。在医疗和非医疗场景中，它常被用来增强认知、减轻疲劳以及提高警觉性。

莫达非尼已被美国食品药品监督管理局批准用于治疗阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、轮班工作睡眠障碍和发作性睡病。 然而，研究表明莫达非尼在超说明书使用时，对于缓解抑郁症、双相情感障碍、帕金森病、季节性情感障碍、ADHD 以及其他以疲劳为症状的多种疾病也可能有用。

由于莫达非尼能够产生躯体刺激，它也被各种运动员用作兴奋剂。   最近，它作为一种用来记忆增强、抵制睡眠欲望或需求并提高整体工作效率的「益智药」在主流人群中非常流行。
mechanism:
虽然莫达非尼及其 R-对映异构体阿莫达非尼减少困倦的具体机制尚不完全清楚，但证据表明，这些药物通过直接或间接作用于睡眠/觉醒回路的许多组成部分来促进觉醒。莫达非尼和阿莫达非尼被假设会抑制 GABA 并促进多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素、组胺以及下丘脑分泌素/食欲素的释放。

莫达非尼及其 R-对映异构体阿莫达非尼会增加去甲肾上腺素 (NE) 和多巴胺 (DA)，这可能是通过阻断去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺再摄取转运体（分别为 NET 和 DAT）实现的。NE 在 α-肾上腺素受体上的作用和 DA 在多巴胺 D2 受体上的作用被认为有助于莫达非尼的促醒特性。食欲素是觉醒系统的关键组成部分；因此，假设莫达非尼对食欲素系统的作用可能有助于提高警觉性。此外，莫达非尼可能通过减少对组胺能神经元的 GABA 能抑制，或通过对食欲素能神经元的作用来间接增加组胺。组胺的增加可能有助于莫达非尼的促醒效果以及提高警觉性的潜力。

在缺乏多巴胺转运体 (DAT) 的基因工程小鼠中，莫达非尼缺乏促醒活性，这表明该活性是依赖于 DAT 的。然而，在大鼠中，莫达非尼的促醒作用与苯丙胺不同，并不会被多巴胺受体拮抗剂氟哌啶醇降低。此外，α-甲基-对-酪氨酸（一种多巴胺合成抑制剂）会阻断苯丙胺的作用，但不会阻断莫达非尼诱导的运动活性。
description_en:
(R)-Modafinil (also known as Armodafinil and by the brand names Nuvigil, Artvigil, and Waklert) is a eugeroic substance of the benzhydryl class. Armodafinil is the enantiopure formulation of modafinil (brand name Provigil). As opposed to the racemic formulation, which contains a 50/50 mix of both the (S) and (R) enantiomers, armodafinil consists of just the (R)-enantiomer of modafinil.
Armodafinil was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in June 2007 for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea, shift work sleep disorder, and narcolepsy.
In addition to its wakefulness-promoting effects and ability to increase locomotor activity in animals, armodafinil can produce rewarding psychoactive and euphoric effects such as alterations in mood, perception, thinking, and feelings typically observed with other central nervous system (CNS) stimulants in humans. 
A study in which patients were administered modafinil, methylphenidate, and a placebo found that armodafinil produces "psychoactive and euphoric effects and feelings consistent with methylphenidate." Relative to modafinil, armodafinil reaches its peak concentration in the blood later after administration than modafinil does, which may make it more effective at improving wakefulness in patients with excessive daytime sleepiness.
The long-term risks of regular armodafinil intake have yet to be studied in detail.

title: 菲尼布特
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
β-苯基-γ-氨基丁酸（也称为 Fenibut、Phenybut、Noofen、Citrocard，通常称为 菲尼布特）是一种鲜为人知的加巴喷丁类抑制剂。[[2]](#cite_note-six-2)[[3]](#cite_note-seven-3) 菲尼布特作为GABA的受体激动剂发挥作用，GABA是大脑中主要的抑制性神经递质。 它在化学上与巴氯芬、普瑞巴林和加巴喷丁有关。[[4]](#cite_note-one-4)

菲尼布特于1960年代在苏联开发，在那里它被用作药物来治疗各种各样的疾病，包括创伤后应激障碍、焦虑、抑郁、虚弱、失眠、酒精中毒、口吃和前庭障碍等。[[5]](#cite_note-two-5)[[6]](#cite_note-three-6)[[4]](#cite_note-one-4) 在世界其他地方，菲尼布特未被批准用于临床，而是作为营养补充剂销售。

主观效应包括焦虑抑制、镇静、肌肉松弛、动机增强和欣快感。较低剂量（低于1克）通常用作认知和生活方式补充剂，而较高剂量则用于娱乐性快感，据报道这种快感在主观上类似于GHB、酒精和某些苯二氮卓类药物。

虽然菲尼布特通常被零售商作为益智药销售，但证明它能增强认知的证据有限。普遍认为菲尼布特在动物和人类中都有抗焦虑作用。[[4]](#cite_note-one-4) 由于其成瘾性，如果要使用这种物质，我们强烈建议采取伤害减少措施哦。
mechanism:
菲尼布特具有比许多其他抑制剂更复杂的药理学特征。 与苯二氮卓类药物不同，菲尼布特作为GABAB受体的完全激动剂，类似于巴氯芬和高剂量的GHB。[[10]](#cite_note-eight-10) 在较高剂量下，菲尼布特失去对GABAB的选择性，并获得作为GABAA激动剂的额外活性。[[11]](#cite_note-ZyablitsevaPavlova2010-11) 菲尼布特在GABAB受体上的作用是其镇静效果的原因。

最近的研究表明，菲尼布特结合并阻断含有α2δ亚基的电压依赖性钙通道（VDCCs），类似于加巴喷丁和普瑞巴林等加巴喷丁类药物。[[12]](#cite_note-nine-12) 菲尼布特的两种对映体都显示出这种作用，且功效相似。相对于GABAB受体，R-对映体对含有α2δ亚基的电压门控钙通道具有五倍的亲和力，而S-对映体在GABAB受体上没有任何功效。[[12]](#cite_note-nine-12)

菲尼布特在啮齿动物中的镇痛作用不是由GABAB受体介导的，而是由阻断含有α2δ亚基的电压门控钙通道介导的。[[12]](#cite_note-nine-12)
description_en:
β-Phenyl-γ-aminobutyric acid (also known as Fenibut, Phenybut, Noofen, Citrocard, and commonly as Phenibut) is a lesser-known depressant substance of the gabapentinoid class. 
Phenibut acts as a receptor agonist for GABA, the major inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. 
It is chemically related to baclofen, pregabalin, and gabapentin.
Phenibut was developed in the Soviet Union in the 1960s, where it has been used as a pharmaceutical drug to treat a wide variety of conditions, including post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety, depression, asthenia, insomnia, alcoholism, stuttering, and vestibular disorders, and others. In the rest of the world, phenibut is not approved for clinical use and is instead sold as a nutritional supplement. 
Subjective effects include anxiety suppression, sedation, muscle relaxation, enhanced motivation, and euphoria. Lower doses (under 1 gram) are typically used as a cognitive and lifestyle supplement while higher doses are used for a recreational high that is reported to be subjectively similar to GHB, alcohol, and certain benzodiazepines. 
Although phenibut is commonly marketed as a nootropic by retailers, evidence that it enhances cognition is limited. It is generally accepted that phenibut has anxiolytic effects in both animal and in humans. Due to its habit-forming properties, it is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.
mechanism_en:
Phenibut has a more complex pharmacological profile than many other depressants. Unlike benzodiazepines, phenibut acts as a full agonist at GABAB receptors, similar to baclofen and high-dose GHB. At higher doses, phenibut loses its selectivity for GABAB and gains additional activity as a GABAA agonist. Phenibut's action at GABAB receptors is responsible for its sedative effects.

Recent research has shown that phenibut binds to and blocks voltage-dependent calcium channels (VDCCs) containing alpha-2-delta subunits, analogously to gabapentinoid drugs such as gabapentin and pregabalin. Both enantiomers of phenibut exhibit this action with similar efficacy. The R-enantiomer displays fivefold greater affinity for alpha-2-delta-containing voltage-gated calcium channels relative to GABAB receptors, while the S-enantiomer shows no efficacy at GABAB receptors.

The analgesic effects of phenibut in rodents are mediated not by GABAB receptors but by blockade of voltage-gated calcium channels containing alpha-2-delta subunits.

title: 萘哌甲酯
description:
免责声明： 本站的给药剂量信息来自用户与各类资料，仅供教育用途呢。这并不是推荐，请务必结合其他来源核实其准确性哦。

萘哌甲酯（也称 HDMP-28）是一种新型合成兴奋剂，属于取代苄基哌啶类物质这一化学类别。它是常用于治疗 ADHD 的药物哌甲酯（例如 Ritalin、Concerta）的结构类似物，在给药后会产生中等强度的兴奋效应。

和苄基哌啶类物质的其他成员一样，萘哌甲酯一般被认为通过充当单胺再摄取抑制剂而起效。不过，有报告称它在主观效应上与传统的多巴胺能兴奋剂存在明显差异呢。这可能与它对血清素再摄取抑制具有较明显作用有关，而这一点通常并不会出现在典型的哌甲酯类似物上。

目前关于萘哌甲酯的药理特性、代谢和毒性的数据非常少，而且它几乎没有人类使用历史。它有时会被网络卖家作为处于灰色地带的研究用化学品进行商业销售，与乙基哌甲酯、异丙基哌甲酯以及4F-MPH等其他哌甲酯类似物一同出现。如果你选择使用它的话，强烈建议以足够谨慎的态度对待这种研究仍不充分的兴奋剂，并采取适当的伤害减少措施哦。
mechanism: 萘哌甲酯被认为主要作为一种单胺三重再摄取抑制剂起效，也就是说，它会通过与通常负责将这些单胺从突触间隙中清除掉的转运蛋白结合，并部分阻断这些蛋白，从而有效提高全脑及中枢神经系统内多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素和血清素等神经递质的水平。这会使这些分子在大脑内累积，尤其是在奖赏通路中，进而产生刺激和欣快效应。
description_en:
Disclaimer: The dosage information on this website has been compiled from user reports and other resources for educational purposes only and does not constitute a recommendation; accuracy should be verified against additional sources.

Methylnaphthidate (also known as HDMP-28) is a novel synthetic stimulant of the substituted benzylpiperidine chemical class. It is a structural analog of methylphenidate (e.g., Ritalin, Concerta), a drug commonly used in the treatment of ADHD, and produces moderate stimulant effects upon administration.

Like other members of the benzylpiperidine class, methylnaphthidate is generally believed to act as a monoamine reuptake inhibitor. However, reports indicate that its subjective effects differ noticeably from those of conventional dopaminergic stimulants. This may be related to its apparently more pronounced inhibition of serotonin reuptake, a property not typically associated with standard methylphenidate analogs.

Very little data currently exists on the pharmacological properties, metabolism, and toxicity of methylnaphthidate, and it has virtually no history of human use. It is sometimes commercially sold by online vendors as a gray-market research chemical, alongside other methylphenidate analogs such as ethylphenidate, isopropylphenidate, and 4F-MPH. Anyone who chooses to use this insufficiently studied stimulant should exercise considerable caution and adopt appropriate harm reduction practices.
mechanism_en: Methylnaphthidate is believed to act primarily as a monoamine triple reuptake inhibitor—that is, it binds to and partially blocks the transporter proteins normally responsible for clearing dopamine, norepinephrine, and serotonin from the synaptic cleft, effectively elevating levels of these neurotransmitters throughout the brain and central nervous system. This leads to an accumulation of these molecules in the brain, particularly within reward pathways, producing stimulant and euphoric effects.

title: 蓝柄裸盖菇
description: 蓝柄裸盖菇 是裸盖菇属中一种效力较强的迷幻蘑菇。研究表明，蓝柄裸盖菇的子实体中含有多种不同的吲哚生物碱，包括赛洛西宾、赛洛辛和贝奥囊素。
description_en: Psilocybe caerulipes is a potent psychedelic mushroom within the genus Psilocybe. Research has shown that the fruiting bodies of Psilocybe caerulipes contain several distinct indole alkaloids, including psilocybin, psilocin, and baeocystin.

title: 蓝莲花
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description: 延药睡莲变种caerulea（通常称为蓝莲花）是一种分布于非洲东半部大多数地区的睡莲呢。
mechanism:
阿朴啡被认为是主要活性成分，它是一种多巴胺受体激动剂，作用靶点包括D1和D2受体。荷叶碱也是一种重要生物碱，它在5-HT2A受体、5-HT和5-HT受体上表现为拮抗剂，但同时又是D2、D5和5-HT受体的部分激动剂，并且是5-HT和D4受体的激动剂。此外，它还会抑制多巴胺转运体（DAT）。

被称为阿朴啡类的一组生物碱会造成蓝莲花的效应。这个类别中包含许多多巴胺激动剂、广泛的血清素拮抗剂与激动剂，以及各种再摄取抑制剂。阿朴吗啡是阿朴啡的活性代谢物，其儿茶酚结构与多巴胺相似。
description_en:
Nymphaea nouchali var. caerulea (Commonly known as Blue Lotus) is a water lily found throughout most of the eastern half of Africa.

The flower has been used for over 2000 years in teas, herbal blends and in perfumes. 
Like other species in the genus, the plant contains the psychoactive alkaloid aporphine which is thought to be the main constituent causing the effects of the flower, however, it is more likely a group of aporphine alkaloids are working in conjunction to create the various effects as opposed to just aporphine. High potent extracts when ingested or smoked in high doses are reported to produce euphoria and hallucinations.
mechanism_en:
Aporphine is considered the primary active constituent; it is a dopamine receptor agonist acting at both D1 and D2 receptors. Nuciferine is another important alkaloid: it acts as an antagonist at 5-HT2A, 5-HT, and 5-HT receptors while simultaneously acting as a partial agonist at D2, D5, and 5-HT receptors, and as a full agonist at 5-HT and D4 receptors. It also inhibits the dopamine transporter (DAT).

The effects of blue lotus are produced by a group of alkaloids known as the aporphines. This class contains numerous dopamine agonists, a broad range of serotonin antagonists and agonists, and various reuptake inhibitors. Apomorphine, the active metabolite of aporphine, shares a catechol structure similar to that of dopamine.

title: 裸盖菇属
description: 裸盖菇属是一类在世界各地都有分布的有褶蘑菇属呢。这个属最广为人知的是其中具有迷幻剂特性的物种。赛洛辛和赛洛西宾是导致这个属中许多物种产生主观效应的主要迷幻化合物。
description_en: Psilocybe is a genus of gilled mushrooms found throughout the world. The genus is best known for the species within it that possess psychedelic properties. Psilocin and psilocybin are the primary psychedelic compounds responsible for the subjective effects produced by many species within the genus.

title: 褪黑素
description:
在一项为期 5 年的回顾研究中（n=130,828，平均年龄 55.7 岁），褪黑素使用者因心力衰竭住院（19.0% vs 6.6%）或死亡（4.6% vs 2.7%）的可能性是普通人的 2 ~ 4 倍。因果关系尚未得到证实，这些发现是在美国心脏协会上发表的（并非在同行评审的科学期刊上）。

由于个体体重、耐受性、新陈代谢和个人敏感度的差异，请务必从低剂量开始。参见负责任的用药部分。

本站的给药剂量信息收集自用户和相关资源，仅供教育目的使用。这不是医疗建议，应与其他来源核实以确保准确性。

N-乙酰-5-甲氧基色胺（亦称 褪黑素）是色胺类物质中的一种激素。它存在于动物、植物、真菌和细菌中。在动物体内，它的功能是作为一种激素，预测每日黑暗的开始； 它在其他生物体中可能具有不同的功能。

褪黑素具有活性，可以通过将其放入口中并让其在 15 ~ 25 分钟内吸收来进行舌下给药和颊粘膜给药。当口服时，其活性较低。
mechanism: 褪黑素是褪黑素受体 1（皮摩尔结合亲和力）和褪黑素受体 2（纳摩尔结合亲和力）的完全激动剂，两者都属于 G 蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）类别。 褪黑素受体 1 和 2 都是 Gi/o 偶联 GPCRs，尽管褪黑素受体 1 也是 Gq 偶联的。 褪黑素还作为线粒体内的强效自由基清除剂，并通过褪黑素受体的信号转导促进抗氧化酶的表达，如超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、谷胱甘肽还原酶和过氧化氢酶。 褪黑素在肝脏中由细胞色素 P450 酶 CYP1A2 代谢为 6-羟基褪黑素。代谢物与硫酸或葡萄糖醛酸结合后通过尿液排出。5% 的褪黑素以原形药物通过尿液排出。 褪黑素与自由基反应形成的一些代谢物包括环状 3-羟基褪黑素、N1-乙酰-N2-甲酰-5-甲氧基犬尿胺 (AFMK) 和 N1-乙酰-5-甲氧基犬尿胺 (AMK)。
description_en:
N-Acetyl-5-methoxytryptamine (also known as melatonin) is a hormone of the tryptamine class. It is found in animals, plants, fungi, and bacteria. In animals, it functions as a hormone that anticipates the daily onset of darkness; it may have different functions in other organisms.
Melatonin is active and can be taken sublingually and buccally by placing it into one's mouth and allowing it to absorb over a period of 15-25 minutes. It is less active when taken orally. 
Melatonin is commonly used as a medication for insomnia; however, there is insufficient scientific evidence to prove any benefit in this area. It is sold over-the-counter in most pharmacies within the United States and Canada. In other countries, it may require a prescription or not be available.
It should be noted that when purchasing melatonin, dosages may range from 3 - 10mg. While not dangerous, this dosage range is well beyond the effective dose of .25 mg, and may increase instances of drowsiness the next day.

title: 豹斑鹅膏
description: 豹斑鹅膏，也叫豹帽或假赭盖鹅膏（因为它和可食用的赭盖鹅膏长得很像），是一种属于鹅膏菌属的精神活性蘑菇呢。这种蘑菇里的主要精神活性成分是蝇蕈醇。不过嘛，它的主观效应和赛洛西宾蘑菇并不相似。
description_en: Amanita pantherina, also known as the panther cap or false blusher (owing to its resemblance to the edible blusher mushroom), is a psychoactive mushroom belonging to the genus Amanita. The primary psychoactive constituent of this mushroom is muscimol. Its subjective effects are not similar to those of psilocybin mushrooms.

title: 赛洛西宾蘑菇
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
赛洛西宾蘑菇（也被称为神奇蘑菇、迷幻蘑菇或简称为蘑菇）是一类含有赛洛西宾的精神活性真菌家族，赛洛西宾是一种色胺类物质中的致幻剂成分喵。虽然其作用机制尚不完全清楚，但通常认为与血清素受体的激动剂活性有关哦。

赛洛西宾蘑菇分布在各大洲，分类学上已归类出 200 多种，其中效力最强的是裸盖菇属 (Psilocybe)。根据史前岩画中发现的图像，人们认为在有文字记载的历史之前，各种人类文化就已经开始使用它们了呢。

在 20 世纪 50 年代被引入西方世界后，它们引起了公众的广泛关注。随着 LSD 的兴起，它们被纳入了 60 年代的青年反文化运动。迷幻剂的广泛使用引发了社会反弹，并在 1970 年被禁止。

今天，它们是使用最广泛的迷幻物质之一（部分原因是个人种植和采集非常方便）。作为所谓“迷幻复兴”的一部分，目前研究人员正在调查它们在治疗包括焦虑、抑郁、成瘾和其他精神障碍方面的潜力喵。

主观效应包括几何、幻觉状态、时间扭曲、内省增强、概念思维、认知欣快和自我死亡。效应的强度和持续时间会因物种和批次等因素而有很大差异，这使得标准化的剂量信息变得复杂（参见此章节）。它们经常被描述为能唤起宗教致幻、类似神秘体验或超个人的体验，可能有助于自我反思和个人成长呢。
description_en:
Psilocybin mushrooms (also known as magic mushrooms, psychedelic mushrooms, and shrooms) are a family of psychoactive fungi that contain psilocybin, a psychedelic substance of the tryptamine class. The mechanism of action is not fully known, although binding activity at serotonin receptors is thought to be involved.
Psilocybin mushrooms occur on all continents and have been taxonomically classified into over 200 species, the most potent of which belong to the genus Psilocybe. Based on imagery found in prehistoric rock art, they are thought to have been used by various human cultures since before recorded history. 
After being introduced to the Western world in the 1950s, they generated substantial public interest.  Along with LSD, they were incorporated into the youth counterculture movement of the 1960s. Widespread usage of psychedelics provoked a societal backlash, and they were prohibited in 1970.
Today, they are among the most widely used psychedelic substances (partly due to the ease of personal cultivation and harvesting). As a part of the so-called "psychedelic renaissance", they are currently being investigated in the treatment of a number of ailments including anxiety, depression, addiction, and other mental disorders.
Subjective effects include visual geometry, hallucinatory states, time distortion, enhanced introspection, conceptual thinking, euphoria, and ego loss. The intensity and duration of effects can vary greatly depending on factors such as species and batch, which can complicate standardized dosing information (see this section). They are often described to evoke entheogenic, mystical-like, or transpersonal experiences that may facilitate self-reflection and personal growth. 
In distinction to psychedelics like LSD, mescaline, and 2C-B, which may be described as "stimulating", "cerebral", and "bright", psilocybin mushrooms are typically described as having an "earthy", "subliminal", or "dream-like" quality. They also are reported to produce slightly more emotion enhancement, time distortion and ego loss than the aforementioned substances, as well as more nausea, confusion, and sedation.
Unlike most highly prohibited substances, psilocybin mushrooms have low abuse potential and are neither addictive nor physiologically toxic. However, adverse psychological reactions such as severe anxiety, paranoia, delusions and psychosis are always possible, particularly among individuals predisposed to mental disorders. 
It is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.

title: 赛洛辛
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
4-羟基-N,N-二甲基色胺（也称为 4-HO-DMT、4-OH-DMT 和 赛洛辛）是一种色胺类天然来源的致幻剂。赛洛辛是某些蘑菇物种中的主要精神活性成分，也是强效的视觉系宗教致幻剂DMT（也称为 N,N-二甲基色胺）的结构类似物哦。

赛洛辛最早由阿尔伯特·霍夫曼于1958年分离并命名。人们认为它的精神活性源于与神经递质血清素的紧密化学相似性，这使它能够与大脑中对感官和认知过程至关重要的一系列血清素受体位点相互作用呢。

值得注意的是，虽然赛洛辛与赛洛西宾在大多数含赛洛西宾的蘑菇中大量天然共存，但很少遇到其合成形式。轶事报告将纯赛洛辛描述为赛洛西宾蘑菇的更清晰和更具侵略性的版本。

与其他被高度禁止的物质不同，赛洛辛不被认为具有成瘾性或生理毒性。然而，总是可能出现严重焦虑、偏执和精神病等不良心理反应，特别是对于那些有精神疾病倾向的人。如果使用这种物质，强烈建议采取伤害减少措施喵。

内容
description_en:
4-HO-DPT (also known as 4-hydroxy-N,N-dipropyltryptamine and sometimes referred to as Procin) is a psychedelic substance of the tryptamine class. Alexander Shulgin first synthesized 4-HO-DPT and documented it in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved). It is the 4-hydroxyl analog of DPT.
Today it is either used recreationally or as an entheogenic compound and is typically acquired through the use of online research chemical vendors. Due to the difficulty of its synthesis, it remains relatively uncommon even for a substituted tryptamine and has very little history of human usage.

title: 酒石酸氢胆碱
description:
胆碱是一种化学物质，在大脑中充当神经递质乙酰胆碱的前体。胆碱是人类必需的营养素，在降低神经管缺陷风险、脂肪肝和其他病理方面具有明确的作用。[[1]](#cite_note-Zeisel2009-1) 它还用于细胞膜成分的合成。[[2]](#cite_note-Glier2014-2) 胆碱很少以游离碱形式出售；为了稳定性，它通常与酸结合形成盐，如酒石酸氢胆碱，或结合成更复杂的形式之一，如胞二磷胆碱。

胆碱补充剂可用于治疗肝脏疾病、[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4) 肝炎、青光眼、[[5]](#cite_note-5) 动脉粥样硬化、阿尔茨海默病、[[6]](#cite_note-6) 双相情感障碍[[7]](#cite_note-7) 以及可能的其他神经系统疾病。[[1]](#cite_note-Zeisel2009-1) 研究还表明，它对患有酒精依赖症的人有积极影响。[[8]](#cite_note-8)[[9]](#cite_note-9)

据报道，当作为补充剂服用时，这种化合物会产生益智效应。它很容易获得，通常通过在线补充剂供应商以此目的出售。
mechanism:
胆碱及其代谢物主要用于三个生理目的：

磷脂合成。胆碱是制造各种磷脂所必需的，磷脂构成了细胞膜和信号脂筏。[[13]](#cite_note-ze-13) 神经脂筏在精神病学领域越来越受到关注。[[14]](#cite_note-14) 胆碱能神经传递，作为乙酰胆碱合成的前体。[[2]](#cite_note-Glier2014-2) 补充胆碱可能使乙酰胆碱积累到比原本更高的水平。由于乙酰胆碱参与记忆功能，这可能解释了其益智效应。[来源请求] 三甲胺 (甜菜碱) 的产生。三甲胺是渗透调节所必需的。它也参与SAM-e的合成。[[2]](#cite_note-Glier2014-2)
description_en:
Choline is a chemical substance which serves as a precursor to the neurotransmitter acetylcholine in the brain. Choline is an essential nutrient in humans, with documented roles in reducing the risk of neural tube defects, fatty liver disease and other pathologies. It is also used in the synthesis of components in cell membranes. Choline is rarely sold as a free base; it is generally combined with an acid to form a salt such as choline bitartrate for stability, or conjugated into one of the more complex forms such as citicoline.
Choline supplementation can be used in the treatment of liver disorders, hepatitis, glaucoma, atherosclerosis, Alzheimer's disease, bipolar disorder and possibly other neurological disorders. It has also been shown to have a positive effect on those suffering from alcoholism. 
When taken as a supplement, this compound has been reported to produce nootropic effects. It is easily available and commonly sold for this purpose through the use of online supplement vendors.
mechanism_en:
Choline and its metabolites serve three primary physiological functions:

Phospholipid synthesis. Choline is necessary for the production of various phospholipids, which form cell membranes and signaling lipid rafts. Neural lipid rafts are receiving increasing attention in the field of psychiatry. Cholinergic neurotransmission, as a precursor to acetylcholine synthesis. Choline supplementation may allow acetylcholine to accumulate to higher levels than would otherwise occur. Since acetylcholine is involved in memory function, this may explain the nootropic effects. [citation needed] Production of trimethylamine (betaine). Trimethylamine is necessary for osmoregulation and is also involved in the synthesis of SAM-e.

title: 酒精
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
当酒精与其他抑制剂（Depressants）如阿片类药物、苯二氮卓类药物、巴比妥类药物、加巴喷丁类物质、噻吩二氮卓类物质或其他 GABA 类物质联用时，可能会导致致命的药物过量。

我们强烈不建议将这些物质混合使用，特别是在中等到严重剂量的情况下。

大概这二十年来，世界卫生组织（WHO）下属的国际癌症研究机构（IARC）一直把酒精列为 1 类致癌物。 世卫组织强调说，「没有所谓的安全饮酒量是不影响健康的」。令人担忧的是，世卫组织还指出，在欧洲地区，几乎一半的酒精归因癌症都与饮酒有关，哪怕只是「轻微」或「适度」的饮酒也不例外。

乙醇（Ethanol，也就是大家常说的 酒精、乙基氢氧化物、饮用酒 或者简单地叫 酒）是醇类的一种抑制剂物质。它是酒精饮料、烈酒和利口酒中的主要精神活性成分；这让它成为了全球第二大广泛使用的娱乐性物质（仅次于咖啡因）。被称为啤酒的酒精饮料是世界上继水和茶之后消费量最大的饮料。乙醇的主要作用是与大脑部分区域的 GABA 受体结合，但也因其对各种神经递质和受体位点的激活和/或相互作用而表现出「混杂」的药理活性。

乙醇只是几种醇类中的一种；其他的醇类，比如甲醇和异丙醇，毒性要大得多。 轻微、短暂地接触异丙醇（它的毒性只是比乙醇稍大一点点）不太可能造成严重的伤害，但甲醇即使是很少的量也是致命的，哪怕只有 10–15 毫升（2–3 茶匙）这么少。不过，异丙醇和乙醇只是酒精饮料中的精神活性醇类及其类似物中的一小部分。与像乙醇这样的伯醇不同，叔醇不能被氧化成通常有毒的醛或羧酸代谢物。比如说，叔醇 2M2B 的效力是乙醇的 20 倍，并且已经被用于娱乐用途了。
mechanism:
低剂量的乙醇会引起欣快感、减轻焦虑、增加社交能力和热情，显著更高的剂量会导致酒精中毒（醉酒）、木僵、无意识、严重的运动控制丧失以及中枢神经系统功能的普遍抑制（抑制）。长期使用会导致酒精滥用、身体依赖或「酗酒」（这是一个相当宽泛的术语）。

酒精对人类有成瘾性，会导致酒精耐受（对药物的敏感性降低）、酒精戒断综合征（药物依赖）或与酗酒相关的健康问题。众所周知，它会对健康产生许多不利影响。当摄入足够量时，该药物已被判定具有神经毒性。  在高剂量或药物过量的情况下，酒精可能会导致意识丧失，严重情况下甚至导致死亡。它是许多交通事故和因醉酒驾驶导致的车辆死亡的肇事因素。它还与社会上相当大比例的暴力犯罪有关。

过去，人们认为酒精是一种非特异性药理制剂，影响大脑中的许多神经递质系统。 虽然这种观点仍有一定道理，但为了更全面地了解其精确的药效学而对其分子药理学进行的进一步研究表明，酒精只有几个主要靶点，特别是通过（增强/促进）某些 GABA 受体。然而，其整体药理学特征和效果范围仍可被视为在某些系统中具有促进作用（如 GABA），而在其他系统中具有抑制作用。

这种对某些神经递质系统的增强作用列举如下，其中乙醇（酒精）已知具有以下功能：

GABAA 受体 正向变构调节剂（主要是含 δ 亚基的受体） 与苯二氮卓类和巴比妥类药物类似，增强名为 GABA 的抑制系统会诱导神经以及更广泛的生理抑制。这增强了行为抑制中心，从而减缓了对来自感官的新信息的处理，抑制了各种类型的认知思维过程，并普遍诱导了正常躯体和认知功能的抑制。然而，该药物通常同时调节其他神经递质系统，特别是在适度剂量下，似乎可以在一定程度上；甚至足以抵消或至少减轻其中一些认知抑制，这使得它与其他几乎完全导致神经/生理抑制的 GABA 类药物相比相对独特，无论剂量如何，而酒精则表现出「平衡木」式的神经活动形式。 5-HT3 受体 激动剂 甘氨酸受体 烟碱乙酰胆碱受体 腺苷：乙醇通过抑制支气管上皮细胞中的核苷转运系统来阻断腺苷摄取。乙醇抑制腺苷摄取导致细胞外腺苷积累增加，影响腺苷在上皮细胞表面的作用，这可能会改变气道稳态。

description_en:
Ethanol (also known as ethyl alcohol, ethyl hydroxide, drinking alcohol or simply alcohol) is a depressant substance of the alcohol class. It is the primary psychoactive component of alcoholic drinks, liquors and spirits; making it the second-most widely used recreational substance globally (after caffeine). The alcoholic beverage known as beer is the most widely consumed beverage in the world after water and tea. Ethanol principally acts by binding to GABA receptors in parts of the brain, but is also known to exhibit “promiscuous” pharmacological activity due to its activation of and/or interaction with various neurotransmitters and receptor sites.
Ethanol is only one of several alcohols; other alcohols such as methanol and isopropyl alcohol are significantly more toxic. A mild, brief exposure to isopropyl alcohol (which is only moderately more toxic than ethanol) is unlikely to cause any serious harm, but methanol is lethal even in small quantities, as little as 10–15 milliliters (2–3 teaspoons).  However, isopropyl alcohol, and ethanol, are just a few psychoactive alcohols in alcoholic drinks, and analogues. Unlike primary alcohols like ethanol, tertiary alcohols cannot be oxidized into aldehyde or carboxylic acid metabolites, which are often toxic. For example, the tertiary alcohol 2M2B is  20 times more potent than ethanol, and has been used recreationally.
The practice of consuming ethanol in the form of alcoholic drinks predates written history. Alcoholic beverages have been produced and consumed by humans since the Neolithic Era, from hunter-gatherer communities to nation-states. In modern times, drinking alcohol is the most commonly used legal recreational substance in the world. More than 100 countries have laws regulating its production, sale, and consumption.
Subjective effects include sedation, disinhibition, anxiety suppression, empathy, affection and sociability enhancement, muscle relaxation, and euphoria. However, the degree to which these effects are present can depend somewhat on the method of production and degree of distillation. Alcoholic beverages are divided into three major classes: beers, wines, and spirits (distilled beverages).
Despite sometimes being considered harmless on basis of its legality and widespread use, ethanol is capable of causing significant harm and toxicity to the user. It is considered to have moderate abuse potential and chronic use is associated with escalating tolerance, physical dependence, and addiction. Additionally, chronic use is associated with negative effects on the brain and other organs. There is also a substantial risk of fatal respiratory overdose when it is combined with other depressants (e.g. benzodiazepines, opioids). As a result, it is highly advised to use harm reduction practices if using this substance.

title: 酪氨酸
description:
酪氨酸（亦称L-酪氨酸或4-羟基苯丙氨酸）是一种非必需氨基酸，是人体内多巴胺、肾上腺素和去甲肾上腺素的前体。作为补充剂时，据称它会表现出轻度兴奋作用。它同时也是细胞用于合成蛋白质的22种氨基酸之一，并广泛存在于许多高蛋白食物中，例如鸡肉、火鸡肉、鱼、茅屋奶酪、奶酪、酸奶、杏仁、牛奶、牛油果、香蕉、花生、南瓜籽、芝麻和豆制品。

有一些证据表明，在某些条件下，尤其是处于压力状态时，补充酪氨酸可能会影响工作记忆任务中的表现。酪氨酸还可能增强聚合性（双任务）思维。在一项研究中，酪氨酸甚至似乎逆转了一部分睡眠剥夺对认知表现的不利影响。不过嘛，如果酪氨酸是通过提高儿茶酚胺水平来提升工作记忆表现，那么这种效应也很容易只是短暂的。一些动物研究显示，多巴胺水平会很快回到基线。
mechanism:
![Tyrosine_metabolism2.png](/文件/Tyrosine_metabolism2.png)

这张图展示了酪氨酸转化为多种儿茶酚胺的机制哦。

酪氨酸作为补充剂或精神活性化合物所产生的效应，源于它是儿茶酚胺类神经递质的前体。补充的L-酪氨酸会在体内转化为L-DOPA，随后再脱羧形成多巴胺，之后进一步转变为去甲肾上腺素，最终再转化为肾上腺素。这意味着它确实会提升大脑中这些神经递质的水平，从而带来兴奋和欣快效应呢。这三种神经递质合称为“儿茶酚胺”。

体内儿茶酚胺的合成过程受限于局部底物池，因此酪氨酸的主观效应在严重给药剂量下往往会达到一个“上限”，此时若继续补充，以增强刺激效果为目的的做法通常会失去作用。

除了作为一种蛋白质生成性氨基酸之外，酪氨酸还因其酚基官能团而具有特殊作用。它存在于参与信号转导过程的蛋白质中，并作为蛋白激酶转移来的磷酸基团受体。羟基的磷酸化可以改变目标蛋白的活性，也可能通过SH2结构域结合而成为信号级联反应的一部分。
description_en:
Tyrosine (also known as L-Tyrosine and 4-hydroxyphenylalanine) is a non-essential amino acid that serves a precursor to dopamine, adrenaline and norepinephrine in the human body. As a supplement, it is reported to act as a mild stimulant. It is also one of the 22 amino acids that are used by cells to synthesize proteins and is abundant in many high-protein foods, such as chicken, turkey, fish, cottage cheese, cheese, yogurt, almonds, milk, avocados, bananas, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, sesame seeds and soy products.
Some evidence suggests tyrosine supplementation can affect performance on working memory tasks under certain conditions, especially stress. Tyrosine may enhance convergent (double-task) thinking. In one study, tyrosine even seemed to reverse some of the detrimental effects of sleep deprivation on cognitive performance. However, if tyrosine increases working memory performance by elevating catecholamine levels, the effect could easily be short-lived. Some animal studies have shown dopamine levels quickly return to baseline.
mechanism_en:
The effects produced by tyrosine as a supplement or psychoactive compound arise from its role as a precursor to the catecholamine neurotransmitters. Supplemental L-tyrosine is converted in the body to L-DOPA, which is subsequently decarboxylated to dopamine, then further converted to norepinephrine, and finally to epinephrine. This means it does raise the levels of these neurotransmitters in the brain, producing stimulant and euphoric effects. These three neurotransmitters are collectively referred to as "catecholamines."

The synthesis of catecholamines in the body is limited by the local substrate pool, so the subjective effects of tyrosine tend to reach a "ceiling" at high doses, beyond which further supplementation for the purpose of enhancing stimulation typically becomes ineffective.

Beyond its role as a proteinogenic amino acid, tyrosine has additional functions owing to its phenolic hydroxyl group. It is found in proteins involved in signal transduction processes, where it acts as a phosphate group acceptor from protein kinases. Phosphorylation of the hydroxyl group can alter the activity of the target protein or serve as part of a signaling cascade through SH2 domain binding.

title: 金刚烷胺
description:

金刚烷胺是一种金刚烷类物质的致幻剂和弱兴奋剂，给药后会产生持久的解离和谵妄效应喵。它是金刚烷胺的衍生物，在药理学上与美金刚、金刚乙胺和阿达丙胺等化合物相关呢。

金刚烷胺最初于 1960 年代作为治疗流感的抗病毒药物被合成出来。1969 年，人们偶然发现金刚烷胺具有中枢多巴胺能兴奋剂样特性，由于其能够增加大脑中多巴胺水平，因此被引入用于治疗帕金森病哦。[[1]](#cite_note-1)
mechanism:
更多信息：NMDA受体拮抗剂类药物

金刚烷胺是一种弱 NMDA 受体拮抗剂（Ki = 10 µM）[[4]](#cite_note-4)，能增加多巴胺释放，并阻断多巴胺再摄取。[[5]](#cite_note-Adamantane_Pharmacology-5) 此外，金刚烷胺还抑制烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体（nAChRs）呢。[[6]](#cite_note-6)

研究发现金刚烷胺与 σ1 受体结合并作为其激动剂（Ki = 7.44 µM），而 σ1 受体的激活参与了多巴胺能效应喵。[[7]](#cite_note-7)

金刚烷胺的抗病毒和精神活性作用机制是不相关的哦。金刚烷胺抗病毒活性的机制涉及对病毒蛋白 M2（一种质子通道）的干扰呢。[[8]](#cite_note-8)
description_en:
Amantadine is a hallucinogen and weak stimulant of the adamantane class that produces lasting dissociative and delirious effects upon administration. It is a derivative of adamantane and is pharmacologically related to compounds such as memantine, rimantadine, and adapromine.

Amantadine was originally synthesized in the 1960s as an antiviral agent for the treatment of influenza. In 1969, it was serendipitously discovered that amantadine possessed central dopaminergic stimulant-like properties, and it was subsequently introduced for the treatment of Parkinson's disease owing to its ability to increase dopamine levels in the brain.
mechanism_en:
Amantadine is a weak NMDA receptor antagonist (Ki = 10 µM) that increases dopamine release and blocks dopamine reuptake. It also inhibits nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (nAChRs).

Amantadine has been found to bind to and act as an agonist at the σ1 receptor (Ki = 7.44 µM), and activation of the σ1 receptor has been implicated in the dopaminergic effects.

The antiviral and psychoactive mechanisms of action of amantadine are unrelated. The mechanism underlying amantadine's antiviral activity involves interference with the viral protein M2, a proton channel.

title: 银冠玉
description: 银冠玉（Lophophora fricii，又称假佩奥特）是一种属于乌羽玉属的仙人掌。它的佩落碱和安哈罗尼定含量较高，而麦斯卡林含量较低。Habermann 1978a 曾报告称，一株人工栽培的 L. fricii 在 3 克/千克剂量下不具有致幻性。
description_en: Lophophora fricii (also known as false peyote) is a cactus belonging to the genus Lophophora. It contains relatively high concentrations of pellotine and anhalonidine, but low concentrations of mescaline. Habermann (1978a) reported that a cultivated specimen of L. fricii was non-hallucinogenic at a dose of 3 g/kg.

title: 阿普唑仑
description:
当苯二氮卓类物质与其他抑制剂（如阿片类药物、巴比妥类物质、加巴喷丁类物质、噻吩二氮卓类物质、酒精或其他 GABA 能物质）联用时，可能导致致命的药物过量。

强烈建议不要联用这些物质，尤其是在中等到严重剂量时。

由于个体体重、耐受性、新陈代谢和个人敏感度的差异，请务必从低剂量开始。参见负责任的用药部分。

本站的给药剂量信息收集自用户和相关资源，仅供教育目的使用。这不是医疗建议，应与其他来源核实以确保准确性。

阿普唑仑（亦称 赞安诺）是一种苯二氮卓类物质的抑制剂物质。其特征性效应包括焦虑抑制、镇静、去抑制和肌肉松弛。
mechanism:
苯二氮卓类通过与苯二氮卓受体位点结合并放大神经递质 γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）的效率和效应来产生多种效应，作用于其受体。 阿普唑仑是 GABAA 型受体的正向变构调节剂。由于该位点是大脑中最丰富的抑制性受体组，其调节导致阿普唑仑对神经系统的镇静（或镇静效应）。苯二氮卓类的抗惊厥特性可能部分或全部归因于与电压依赖性钠通道的结合，而非苯二氮卓受体。

阿普唑仑导致下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴的显著抑制。已证明阿普唑仑的给药会引起纹状体多巴胺浓度的增加。 这导致包括减少焦虑、肌肉松弛、抗抑郁和抗惊厥活性在内的效应。GABA 化学物质和受体系统介导阿普唑仑对神经系统的抑制或镇静效应。阿普唑仑与 GABAA 受体（一种氯离子通道）的结合增强了 GABA（一种神经递质）的效应。当 GABA 与 GABAA 受体结合时，通道打开，氯离子进入细胞，使其更难去极化。因此，阿普唑仑对突触传递有抑制作用，从而减少焦虑。

GABAA 受体由 19 种可能的亚基中的 5 个组成，由不同亚基组合组成的 GABAA 受体具有不同的特性、在大脑中的不同位置，以及重要的是，对苯二氮卓类的不同活性。阿普唑仑和其他三唑苯二氮卓类（如三唑仑）具有与其二氮卓环稠合的三唑环，似乎具有抗抑郁特性。 这可能是由于与三环类抗抑郁药的相似性，因为它们有两个苯环与一个二氮卓环稠合。阿普唑仑的治疗特性与其他苯二氮卓类相似，包括抗焦虑、抗惊厥、肌肉松弛、催眠和遗忘作用；然而，它主要用作抗焦虑药。

与劳拉西泮相比，给予阿普唑仑已被证明会引起纹状体中细胞外多巴胺 D1 和 D2 浓度的统计学显著增加。
description_en:
Alprazolam (also known as Xanax) is a depressant substance of the benzodiazepine class. Its characteristic effects include anxiety suppression, sedation, disinhibition, and muscle relaxation. 
Like other benzodiazepines, alprazolam binds to specific sites on the GABAA receptor. It is commonly used for the medical treatment of panic disorder, generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), or social anxiety disorder (SAD).
Alprazolam has a fast onset of action and symptomatic relief. 90% of peak effects are achieved within the 1st hour of using in preparation for panic disorder and full peak effects are achieved in 1.5 and 1.6 hours respectively. Peak benefits achieved for GAD may take up to a week.
The sudden discontinuation of benzodiazepines can be potentially dangerous or life-threatening for individuals using regularly for extended periods of time, sometimes resulting in seizures or death. It is highly recommended to taper one's dose by gradually lowering the amount taken each day for a prolonged period of time instead of stopping abruptly.

title: 阿莫达菲尼
description:
免责声明：本网站的给药剂量信息仅为教育目的而汇编自使用者与各类资料，并不构成推荐，准确性仍应以其他来源进一步核实呢。

(R)-莫达菲尼（又称阿莫达非尼，商品名包括Nuvigil、Artvigil与Waklert）是一种属于二苯甲基类物质的促醒剂。阿莫达非尼是莫达菲尼（商品名Provigil）的对映体纯制剂。与同时含有(S)与(R)对映体各50%的外消旋制剂不同，阿莫达非尼仅由莫达菲尼的(R)-对映异构体构成哦。

阿莫达非尼于2007年6月获美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准，用于治疗阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、轮班工作睡眠障碍与发作性睡病。

除了促进清醒以及在动物中提高运动活动能力之外，阿莫达非尼还可能产生带有奖赏性的精神活性与欣快效应，例如情绪、感知、思维和感受方面的改变，这些在人类使用其他中枢神经系统兴奋剂时也常能观察到呢。

一项让患者接受莫达菲尼、哌甲酯以及安慰剂给药的研究发现，阿莫达非尼会产生“与哌甲酯一致的精神活性、欣快效应与主观感受”。相较于莫达菲尼，阿莫达非尼在给药后达到血药峰浓度的时间更晚，因此它在改善白天过度嗜睡患者的清醒状态方面，可能会更有效一些。
mechanism:
![Rsmodafinil-moa.svg](/文件/Rsmodafinil-moa.png)

(R,S)-莫达菲尼的作用机制。

尽管莫达菲尼及其R-对映体阿莫达非尼降低困倦感的确切机制尚未被完全阐明，但现有证据提示，这些物质会通过直接或间接作用于睡眠/觉醒回路中的多个组成部分来促进清醒。莫达菲尼与阿莫达非尼被推测可抑制GABA，并促进多巴胺、去甲肾上腺素、组胺以及食欲素/下丘脑分泌素的活性。

莫达菲尼及其R-对映体阿莫达非尼都会提高去甲肾上腺素（NE）与多巴胺（DA）水平，这可能是通过同时阻断NE与DA的再摄取转运体（分别为NET与DAT）实现的。NE在α-肾上腺素能受体上的作用，以及DA在多巴胺D2受体上的作用，被认为共同促成了莫达菲尼的促醒特性。食欲素是唤醒系统中的关键组成部分，因此，推测中的莫达菲尼对食欲素能系统的作用，可能有助于提升警觉性。此外，莫达菲尼还可能通过减少GABA能神经元对组胺能神经元的抑制，或通过作用于食欲素能神经元，间接提高组胺水平。组胺的升高，可能同时促成莫达菲尼的促醒作用以及其提高警觉性的潜力。

在经基因工程改造、缺失多巴胺转运体（DAT）的小鼠中，莫达菲尼失去了促醒活性，这提示该活性依赖DAT。不过，莫达菲尼的促醒效应与苯丙胺不同，在大鼠中不会被多巴胺受体拮抗剂氟哌啶醇削弱。此外，作为多巴胺合成抑制剂的α-甲基-p-酪氨酸能够阻断苯丙胺的作用，却不能阻断由莫达菲尼诱发的运动活性。
description_en:
(R)-Modafinil (also known as armodafinil, sold under the brand names Nuvigil, Artvigil, and Waklert) is a wakefulness-promoting agent of the diphenylmethyl class. Armodafinil is the enantiopure formulation of modafinil (brand name Provigil). Unlike the racemic formulation, which contains equal 50% proportions of the (S) and (R) enantiomers, armodafinil consists solely of the (R)-enantiomer of modafinil.

Armodafinil received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in June 2007 for the treatment of obstructive sleep apnea, shift work sleep disorder, and narcolepsy.

Beyond promoting wakefulness and increasing locomotor activity in animals, armodafinil may also produce rewarding psychoactive and euphoric effects — such as alterations in mood, perception, thinking, and sensation — that have also been observed with other central nervous system stimulants in humans.

A study in which patients received modafinil, methylphenidate, and placebo found that armodafinil produced "psychoactive and euphoric effects and feelings consistent with methylphenidate." Compared with modafinil, armodafinil reaches peak plasma concentration later following administration, and as a result may be more effective at improving wakefulness in patients with excessive daytime sleepiness.
mechanism_en:
Although the precise mechanism by which modafinil and its R-enantiomer armodafinil reduce sleepiness has not been fully elucidated, available evidence suggests that these substances promote wakefulness through direct or indirect actions on multiple components of the sleep/wake circuit. Modafinil and armodafinil are hypothesized to inhibit GABA and to promote the activity of dopamine, norepinephrine, histamine, and orexin/hypocretin.

Both modafinil and armodafinil elevate norepinephrine (NE) and dopamine (DA) levels, likely by simultaneously blocking the NE and DA reuptake transporters (NET and DAT, respectively). The actions of NE at α-adrenergic receptors and of DA at dopamine D2 receptors are thought to contribute jointly to the wake-promoting properties of modafinil. Orexin is a key component of the arousal system, and the postulated action of modafinil on the orexinergic system may therefore contribute to increased alertness. Modafinil may also indirectly raise histamine levels either by reducing GABAergic inhibition of histaminergic neurons or by acting on orexinergic neurons. Elevated histamine may contribute simultaneously to modafinil's wake-promoting effects and to its potential to enhance alertness.

In mice genetically engineered to lack the dopamine transporter (DAT), modafinil loses its wake-promoting activity, suggesting that this activity is DAT-dependent. However, the wake-promoting effects of modafinil differ from those of amphetamine in that they are not attenuated by the dopamine receptor antagonist haloperidol in rats. Furthermore, α-methyl-p-tyrosine, a dopamine synthesis inhibitor, can block the effects of amphetamine but not the locomotor activity induced by modafinil.

title: 颠茄
description: 颠茄，通常也被称为颠茄或致命龙葵，是一种属于茄科的植物，原产于欧洲、北非和西亚。它含有属于谵妄剂的托烷类物质。其叶片和浆果都具有极强毒性，内含托烷类生物碱。这些毒素包括阿托品、东莨菪碱和莨菪碱。它们会引发怪异的谵妄与幻觉（与曼陀罗类似），同时也被用作药用抗胆碱剂。
description_en: Atropa belladonna, commonly known as belladonna or deadly nightshade, is a plant of the family Solanaceae, native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. It contains tropane substances that are deliriants. Both its leaves and berries are highly toxic and contain tropane alkaloids, including atropine, scopolamine, and hyoscyamine. These toxins produce bizarre delirium and hallucinations (similar to those produced by Datura) and are also used as medicinal anticholinergic agents.

title: 骆驼蓬
description: 骆驼蓬，常被称作叙利亚芸香、哈梅尔、埃斯潘德、埃斯凡德、野芸香、非洲芸香或阿斯潘德，是一种原产于伊朗东部地区至印度一带的植物呢。它也已经作为入侵物种扩散到了亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、俄勒冈州、得克萨斯州和华盛顿州。该植物会产生含有骆驼蓬生物碱的种子，而且通常很容易在网上合法购买到。
description_en: Peganum harmala, commonly called Syrian rue, harmel, espand, esfand, wild rue, African rue, or aspand, is a plant native to the eastern Iranian region west to India. It has also spread invasively throughout Arizona, California, Montana, Nevada, Oregon, Texas and Washington. The plant itself produces seeds which contain harmala alkaloids and is easily accessible and legal to purchase online.

title: 鹅膏蕈氨酸
description:
鹅膏蕈氨酸，或(S)-2-氨基-2-(3-羟基异噁唑-5-基)乙酸（也称鹅膏蕈氨酸盐），是一种天然存在于毒蝇伞及相关蘑菇物种中的精神活性物质。它是神经递质谷氨酸的类似物，并且由于在结构上与这种神经递质相似，因此会作为一种非选择性的谷氨酸受体激动剂发挥作用。

鹅膏蕈氨酸是一种强效神经毒素，在针对大鼠进行的科学研究中，它曾通过颅内注射被用作一种“脑损毁剂”。不过，这些性质尚未在人类身上得到研究；然而，它也很可能同样是一种对人类具有神经毒性的物质呢。
description_en:
Ibotenic acid or (S)-2-amino-2-(3-hydroxyisoxazol-5-yl)acetic acid (also referred to as ibotenate) is a psychoactive substance which occurs naturally in Amanita muscaria and related species of mushrooms. It is an analogue of the neurotransmitter glutamate, and due to its structural similarity to this neurotransmitter, acts as a non-selective glutamate receptor agonist.
Ibotenic acid is a powerful neurotoxin, and has been employed as a "brain-lesioning agent" through cranial injections in scientific research conducted in rats. The same properties have not been studied in humans, however it could very well be a human neurotoxin as well.

title: 鹅花树
description: 鹅花树，或简称伊博加，是一种原产于中非西部的多年生热带雨林灌木，也是一种迷幻剂。在非洲部分生长这种植物的地区，其根皮会被咀嚼，用于各种药理或仪式性用途。其精神活性生物碱伊博格碱，也被用于治疗物质滥用障碍和抑郁。非洲马铃果中也含有少量伊博格碱，以及伊博格碱的前体物质。
description_en: Tabernanthe iboga, or simply iboga, is a perennial tropical rainforest shrub native to western Central Africa and a psychedelic. In parts of Africa where it grows, the root bark is chewed for various pharmacological or ritual purposes. Its psychoactive alkaloid ibogaine is also used in the treatment of substance use disorders and depression. Voacanga africana also contains small amounts of ibogaine and ibogaine precursors.

title: 麦斯卡林
subjective_effects: 共情、爱和社交能力增强
description:
麦斯卡林（也称 3,4,5-三甲氧基苯乙胺）是一种天然存在的经典迷幻剂，属于苯乙胺类物质。 它天然存在于佩奥特仙人掌 (_Lophophora williamsii_)、 圣佩德罗仙人掌 (_Echinopsis pachanoi_)、 秘鲁火炬仙人掌 (_Echinopsis peruviana_) 以及仙人掌科植物和豆科植物家族中。 它是已知最古老的致幻剂之一，也是迷幻苯乙胺类物质的母体化合物，后者是迷幻化合物的两大主要子类之一（另一种是色胺类物质）。

麦斯卡林于 1897 年由德国化学家亚瑟·赫夫特（Arthur Heffter）首次从佩奥特仙人掌中分离出来。 墨西哥的美洲原住民仪式性使用佩奥特仙人掌已有至少 5700 年的历史，其他含有麦斯卡林的仙人掌（如圣佩德罗）在南美大陆（从秘鲁到厄瓜多尔）也有悠久的使用历史。 麦斯卡林是美国化学家亚历山大·舒尔金（Alexander Shulgin）毕生工作的重要组成部分，他以此为起点合成了数十种新型迷幻化合物，这些化合物记录在他 1991 年出版的《PiHKAL》（“我所知和喜爱的苯乙胺类”）一书中。

主观效应包括睁眼和闭眼视觉效果、时间扭曲、内省增强、概念性思维、欣快感和自我迷失。麦斯卡林通常被认为是最温和、最具洞察力和最令人欣快的迷幻剂之一。众所周知，它比赛洛西宾（注：此处原文为psilocybin，指向同类色胺）或DMT等色胺类迷幻剂更强调身体和触觉感受（有时被比作MDMA），后者的思维空间往往更狂乱，视觉几何更具动态。由于其醇厚、有机而又复杂的特性，它被认为是迷幻治疗的最佳药物之一。合成麦斯卡林受到鉴赏家的高度追捧，但由于其效力低且生产成本相对较高，通常只有限量生产。

与其他被严厉禁止的物质不同，麦斯卡林尚未被证明具有生理毒性或成瘾性。 然而， 焦虑 、 妄想 、 错觉和精神病等不良心理反应仍然可能发生，尤其是在那些易患精神疾病的人群中。  此外，还应注意，在街头市场，“麦司卡林”或“合成麦司卡林”等术语通常被用作其他迷幻剂（例如 2C-x 、 DOx 或 25x-NBOMe ）的欺骗性标签，而这些致幻剂通常更危险。如果使用这些物质，强烈建议采用减害措施。
mechanism:
更多信息：迷幻剂

麦斯卡林的作用与其他迷幻剂相似。 它以高亲和力结合并激活血清素 5-HT2A 受体。 激活 5-HT2A 受体如何导致迷幻状态尚不清楚，但它可能以某种方式涉及前额叶皮层神经元的兴奋。 众所周知，麦斯卡林还会结合并激活血清素 5-HT2C 受体。
description_en:
Mescaline (also known as 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine) is a naturally occurring classical psychedelic of the phenethylamine class. It is found naturally in the peyote cactus (Lophophora williamsii), the San Pedro cactus (Echinopsis pachanoi), the Peruvian torch cactus (Echinopsis peruviana), and within the Cactaceae and Fabaceae plant families. It is one of the oldest known psychedelics and the parent compound of the psychedelic phenethylamines, one of the two main subclasses of psychedelic compounds (the other being the tryptamines).

Mescaline was first isolated from the peyote cactus in 1897 by the German chemist Arthur Heffter. Indigenous peoples of Mexico have used peyote ritually for at least 5,700 years, and other mescaline-containing cacti such as San Pedro have a long history of use throughout South America, from Peru to Ecuador. Mescaline was a central focus of the life's work of American chemist Alexander Shulgin, who used it as a starting point for the synthesis of dozens of novel psychedelic compounds, documented in his 1991 book PiHKAL ("Phenethylamines I Have Known and Loved").

Subjective effects include open- and closed-eye visuals, time distortion, increased introspection, conceptual thinking, euphoria, and ego dissolution. Mescaline is generally considered one of the gentlest, most insightful, and most euphoric psychedelics. It is well known for placing more emphasis on physical and tactile sensations than tryptamine-class psychedelics such as psilocybin or DMT (sometimes compared to MDMA), the latter of which tend toward more chaotic mindscapes and more dynamically active visual geometry. Its rich, organic, and complex character has led to its being regarded as one of the premier substances for psychedelic therapy. Synthetic mescaline is highly sought after by connoisseurs, but owing to its low potency and relatively high production costs it is typically available only in limited quantities.

Unlike other heavily prohibited substances, mescaline has not been demonstrated to be physiologically toxic or habit-forming. However, adverse psychological reactions such as anxiety, delusions, illusions, and psychosis are still possible, particularly in individuals predisposed to mental illness. It should also be noted that in street markets, terms such as "mescaline" or "synthetic mescaline" are frequently used as deceptive labels for other psychedelics — such as 2C-x, DOx, or 25x-NBOMe — which are generally more dangerous. Harm reduction practices are strongly recommended if these substances are used.
mechanism_en: Mescaline acts similarly to other psychedelics. It binds to and activates the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor with high affinity. How activation of the 5-HT2A receptor produces a psychedelic state is not fully understood, but it likely involves excitation of neurons in the prefrontal cortex. Mescaline is also known to bind to and activate the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.

title: 麻黄碱
subjective_effects: 共情、情感和社交能力增强
description:
麻黄碱 是一种天然存在的中枢神经系统兴奋剂，从植物木贼麻黄（Ephedra equisetina）中获得。通常用作兴奋剂、注意力辅助剂、减充血剂和食欲抑制剂。它常用于预防脊髓麻醉期间的低血压。

麻黄碱在结构上与甲基苯丙胺和伪麻黄碱密切相关，尽管它的中枢神经系统作用比苯丙胺类物质弱得多，而且作用时间更长。它的外周兴奋作用类似于肾上腺素，但不如肾上腺素强大，肾上腺素是肾上腺在体内产生的一种激素。
mechanism:
麻黄碱的主要作用机制是通过增加儿茶酚胺在 α、β1 和 β2 肾上腺素能 受体上的活性。 它也作为一种 NDRAs（去甲肾上腺素-多巴胺 释放剂）。

麻黄碱是一种拟交感胺，作用于交感神经系统 (SNS) 的一部分。主要作用机制依赖于它通过增加突触后 α 和 β 受体上的去甲肾上腺素活性来间接刺激肾上腺素能受体系统。 是否存在与 α 受体的直接相互作用是不太可能的，但仍有争议。 L-麻黄碱，特别是其立体异构体去甲伪麻黄碱（也存在于恰特草中）具有间接的拟交感神经作用，由于其能够穿过血脑屏障，它是一种类似于苯丙胺的中枢神经系统兴奋剂，但不那么明显，因为它在黑质中释放去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺。

与去甲麻黄碱相比，N-甲基的存在降低了在 α 受体上的结合亲和力。不过，麻黄碱的结合力比 N-甲基麻黄碱好，后者在氮原子上有一个额外的甲基。此外，羟基的空间取向对于受体结合和功能活性也很重要。
description_en:
Ephedrine is a naturally occurring central nervous system stimulant obtained from the plant Ephedra equisetina. It is commonly used as a stimulant, attention aid, decongestant, and appetite suppressant. It is frequently used to prevent hypotension during spinal anesthesia.

Ephedrine is closely related in structure to methamphetamine and pseudoephedrine, although its central nervous system effects are considerably weaker and longer-lasting than those of amphetamine-class compounds. Its peripheral stimulant effects resemble those of epinephrine, though it is less potent than epinephrine, the hormone produced by the adrenal gland in the body.
mechanism_en:
The primary mechanism of action of ephedrine involves increasing the activity of catecholamines at α, β1, and β2 adrenergic receptors. It also acts as an NDRA (norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent).

Ephedrine is a sympathomimetic amine that acts on the sympathetic nervous system (SNS). The primary mechanism of action relies on its ability to indirectly stimulate the adrenergic receptor system by increasing norepinephrine activity at postsynaptic α and β receptors. Whether direct interaction with α receptors occurs is considered unlikely but remains a matter of debate. L-Ephedrine, and in particular its stereoisomer norpseudoephedrine (also found in khat), exerts indirect sympathomimetic effects; owing to its ability to cross the blood-brain barrier, it is a CNS stimulant similar to amphetamine but less pronounced, as it releases norepinephrine and dopamine in the substantia nigra.

Compared with norephedrine, the presence of the N-methyl group reduces binding affinity at α receptors. Nevertheless, ephedrine binds better than N-methylephedrine, which carries an additional methyl group on the nitrogen atom. The spatial orientation of the hydroxyl group is also important for receptor binding and functional activity.

title: 鼠尾草素乙
description:
鼠尾草素乙甲氧甲基醚（2-O-甲氧甲基鼠尾草素乙，或2-MMSB）是一种用于科学研究的天然产物鼠尾草素甲的半合成类似物呢。和鼠尾草素甲不足30分钟的作用时长相比，它的作用时长更长，大约为2至3小时，而且它在κ-阿片受体上的亲和力和效力也更高哦。和相关化合物赫金诺林一样，鼠尾草素乙甲氧甲基醚由鼠尾草素乙制得；而鼠尾草素乙最方便的制备方式，则是由鼠尾草素甲经脱乙酰反应得到，因为虽然鼠尾草素甲和鼠尾草素乙都存在于墨西哥鼠尾草中，但鼠尾草素甲的含量会更高一些嘛。

鼠尾草素乙甲氧甲基醚在κ-阿片受体上的Ki值为0.60nM，在动物研究中，它的效力大约是鼠尾草素甲的五倍哦，不过仍然只有其更强同系物鼠尾草素乙乙氧甲基醚的一半左右呢。
description_en:
Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether (2-O-methoxymethyl salvinorin B, or 2-MMSB) is a semisynthetic analogue of the natural product salvinorin B, prepared for scientific research. Compared with salvinorin A, whose duration of action is under 30 minutes, it has a longer duration of approximately 2 to 3 hours and a higher affinity and potency at the κ-opioid receptor. Like the related compound herkinorin, salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether is prepared from salvinorin B; the most convenient preparation of salvinorin B is by deacetylation of salvinorin A, since although both salvinorin A and salvinorin B are present in Salvia divinorum, salvinorin A is present in higher concentrations.

Salvinorin B methoxymethyl ether has a Ki of 0.60 nM at the κ-opioid receptor and is approximately five times more potent than salvinorin A in animal studies, though it is still roughly half as potent as its more powerful homologue salvinorin B ethoxymethyl ether.

title: 鼠尾草素甲
description:
鼠尾草素甲 (Salvinorin A) 是预言者鼠尾草（Salvia Divinorum）中的主要活性精神活性分子，这是一种墨西哥植物，有着被土著马萨特克萨满作为致幻源使用的悠久历史。它在结构上不同于其他天然存在的致幻剂（如DMT、脱磷酸裸盖菇素和麦斯卡林），因为它不含氮原子，这使它成为一种萜类化合物而不是通常的生物碱。这意味着它不能被制成盐类。

与其它的致幻剂相比，它的主观体验也有所不同，尽管正式分类尚有争议，但它被描述为一种非典型的迷幻剂。[需要引用]

description_en:
Salvinorin A is the main active psychoactive molecule within Salvia Divinorum, a Mexican plant which has a long history of use as an entheogen by indigenous Mazatec shamans. It is structurally distinct from other naturally occurring hallucinogens (such as DMT, psilocin and mescaline) because it contains no nitrogen atoms, making it a terpenoid and not an alkaloid as is the norm. This means it cannot be rendered as a salt. 
It also differs in subjective experience compared to other hallucinogens, and has been described as an atypical psychedelic although this formal classification is debatable.
